bluejetty:00014069:ios.description:
Expensify helps more than 15 million people around the world track expenses, reimburse employees, manage corporate cards, send invoices, pay bills, and book travel. All at the speed of chat.
Expensify is built for:
* Self-employed: Track and categorize expenses for budgeting or tax purposes. Scan receipts, log distance, or just type in an amount. Send invoices to clients and chat with them in the same place.
* Small business owners: Say goodbye to spreadsheets. Keep employees happy with easy expense management and quick reimbursements. Clear up any questions in a chat on the expense or report level. Sync with QuickBooks Online, Xero, and more.
* Growing teams: Scale up your spend management with the Expensify corporate card, built-in travel booking and trip chat rooms, and multi-level approval workflows. Sync with Sage Intacct, NetSuite, and more.
* Enterprise companies: Reimburse employees in every country. Manage expenses in every currency. Import transactions from every type of corporate or personal card.
Key features:
* Chat: Keep your money moving with realtime chat built into every type of transaction.
* Receipt scanning: Snap a picture of any receipt and SmartScan extracts the details.
* Distance tracking: Log miles or kilometers on a beautiful map, at custom rates.
* Manual expenses: No receipt? Just type in an amount. Still better than a spreadsheet.
* Categorization: Code your expenses once and then we’ll learn to do it for you.
* Submissions: Expenses auto-submit in realtime, or you can set a custom cadence.
* Approvals: Add one or more expense approvers to your workflow for more control.
* Expense chat: Questions about an expense? Ask and approve in the same place.
* Reimbursements: Pay back your employees at home or around the world.
* Expensify Card: Get up to 2% cash back on all US purchases and save on your bill.
* Corporate cards: Give your team the Expensify Card or import your own.
* Invoices: Send, view, discuss, and pay invoices in a chat. No more app + email combos.

Play offline anytime, anywhere. No internet connection required. Perfect for killing time while waiting in line, on the bus, or relaxing at home.

Learn while you play. Discover new things, improve your spelling, and expand your vocabulary. It's a fun way to explore the world through pictures.

Challenge friends and family. Who knows more? Compare scores and find out who's the ultimate picture expert.

Available in 22 languages. Play in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Japanese, and many more.

Download Pics Quiz Trivia now and see how many pictures you can guess!

bluejetty:00131047:ios.description:
Boiling an egg, timing a presentation, or starting your next Pomodoro – Disco Timer is a universal countdown clock for all sorts of tasks.
Setting the timer duration is based on 60-minute circle of traditional analog watches – you just wind it up with a single rotary gesture. Then tap the display to run, pause, or reset the timer.
Large, high-contrast representation of the remaining time makes it glanceable from quite a distance. And an option to disable the Auto-Lock can keep the device awake while the timer is running. This comes in very handy when keeping an eye on the progress is as important as the finishing time itself.
The face of the timer can be customized by choosing from a variety of color combinations (Premium feature). And for the completion alert – you can select from a dozen great-sounding tones, all of which are crafted exclusively for Codulis apps.
Give Disco Timer a try, and let us know what you think!

bluejetty:00134303:ios.description:
LiveScore keeps you up to date with the latest live sports scores and live sports action. Whether you are looking for scores, goals, fixtures, or news, LiveScore is your one-stop destination for top soccer leagues. From Premier League and UEFA Champions League, to Eredivisie, Serie A, LaLiga, and more, LiveScore has it all. Stay on top of the soccer season with live soccer scores!
DISCOVER AMERICAN FOOTBALL
New to LiveScore is American Football! Whether you're a seasoned fan or new to the game, we've got you covered with real-time game results, stats, and fixtures for your favorite teams and leagues, including the NFL & CFL. Stay updated on the action and follow every touchdown, tackle, and triumph.
LIVE NOTIFICATIONS
Get fast updates to keep track of live sports scores, goals, red cards, and more for multiple matches and sports at the same time. Get all the details, soccer stats, and live soccer scores for the Premier League, UEFA Champions League; scores for tennis matches and more. Manage your favorite sports & match notifications in your settings.
FOR YOU
Immerse yourself in a truly personalized experience when it comes to news and headlines. With all your favorites in one place, it’s the best way for you to cut the noise and stay informed on the teams and competitions that matter to you. Check the latest news and breaking headlines from across the world of sport. After all, it's made For You.
For You covers everything from the latest insights, soccer news, soccer stats, soccer results, post-match reviews, player transfers, and previews of upcoming soccer fixtures from the PL, UEFA Champions League, LaLiga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Primeira Liga, and Eredivisie.
COMPETITIONS
Search for competitions across the biggest sports. Including worldwide premier cups and leagues with match details and soccer and American football scores for the PL, the FA Cup, UEFA Champions League, LaLiga, Serie A, Eredivisie, and Bundesliga.
FAVORITE LEAGUES AND TEAMS
Get to the scores, live results, and sports match news you’re interested in. Favorite your team to follow their progress in the leagues and easily see past results or upcoming fixtures. Switch on live notifications for your favorited teams to keep track of all the action & news.
TEAM PAGES AND PLAYER STATS
View your team’s upcoming fixtures, live table standings, news, scores, videos of matches, and Player Stats to check top scorers and more. Perfect for keeping up with news and scores of your favorite tennis players, or for your fantasy soccer team.
LIVE COMMENTARY (Unofficial) FROM LIVESCORE
Listen to live match commentary (unofficial) from the LiveScore team, covering everything from scores, assists, corners, cards and descriptions of the action on soccer matches.
WORLDWIDE SCORES AND SPORT
Find your international team and follow live soccer stats, soccer results, and scores. More than 1,000 live soccer scores and soccer fixtures are followed every week.
ABOUT LIVESCORE
Since 1998, LiveScore has been giving you real-time delivery of live sport scores & data. As leaders of live score updates, LiveScore is trusted and used daily by millions of users globally; specializing in the sports: soccer, American football, tennis, cricket, basketball & hockey.

Just point your camera and scan any QR code or barcode in under a second.
Instantly connect to WiFi, open links, save contacts, and check product info.
Create your own QR codes and barcodes too.
▸ Scan
- Point your camera for instant recognition. Supports 20 code formats:
 QR, Micro QR, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, Code 128, Code 39, Code 39 Mod 43, Code 93, Codabar, ITF-14, Interleaved 2 of 5, PDF417, Micro PDF417, Aztec, Data Matrix, GS1 DataBar, GS1 DataBar Limited, GS1 DataBar Expanded
- Batch scan multiple codes continuously without interruption
- Open URLs, add contacts, connect to WiFi, view maps, send emails, make calls, and more — instantly
▸ Scan History
- Automatically saves all scanned and created codes
- View at a glance with code type, date, and product info
- Export history as CSV files
▸ Create
- QR Codes: website, text, email, SMS, phone number, WiFi, contact, location, event/calendar
- Barcodes: EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, ITF-14, Interleaved 2 of 5, Codabar, Data Matrix, Aztec, PDF417, Micro PDF417, Micro QR, GS1 DataBar, GS1 DataBar Limited, GS1 DataBar Expanded
- Social: Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, TikTok, X, YouTube, LinkedIn, Discord, Pinterest, Reddit, Threads, WeChat, KakaoTalk, LINE, GitHub, and 19 platforms total
- Business: Bitcoin, Ethereum, PayPal, Venmo, Cash App, App Store, Google Maps, Zoom, Google Meet, and more
▸ Custom Design
- Freely change colors, dot styles, borders, and center shapes
- Insert social/business platform logos and SF Symbol icons into the QR code center
▸ Product Information
- Food: View nutrition facts, allergen info, Nutri-Score, Eco-Score environmental rating, ingredients, and labels via OpenFoodFacts
- Non-food: View ingredients, labels, packaging info, and environmental ratings for cosmetics, household products, and more via Open Products Facts
▸ Camera
- Switch between wide, ultra-wide, and telephoto lenses
- Tap to focus/adjust exposure
- Zoom controls and flash
▸ Other
- Dark mode support
- 37 languages supported
Download QR Code Scanner now and start scanning!

Privacy Policy: https://spacenodehq.web.app/qr-scanner/privacy.html

bluejetty:00078556:ios.description:
• Terminal Master-Bus Tycoon: Your Ultimate Transportation Empire Adventure! • 
Welcome to Terminal Master-Bus Tycoon, the ultimate arcade idle game for all transportation tycoon gamers! Dive into an addictive and unique experience where you get to build, manage, and expand your very own bus terminal empire. Whether you're a fan of idle games, simulation games, or just love managing a business, this game has everything you need to keep you entertained for hours.
• Key Features:
1. Launch New Bus Terminal Establishments
Start small and grow big! Launch new bus terminals across various locations and connect different parts of the country. Ensure your terminals are the best in the business by providing top-notch services and amenities for your passengers.
2. Clean Up the Buses
Keep your buses spotless and hygienic. Manage a team to clean up trash, restock restroom supplies, and ensure your buses are always ready for the next trip. Clean buses mean happy passengers!
3. Manage Passengers Efficiently
Oversee the flow of passengers as they get on various buses heading to numerous destinations. Make sure everyone gets to where they need to go, on time and with a smile on their face.
4. Upgrade Your Buses
Invest your hard-earned cash to upgrade your fleet. Better buses mean more passengers, more money, and a more extensive transportation empire. From standard upgrades to luxury VIP options, ensure your buses are the top of the line.
5. Expand Your Business Across the Country
Don’t just stop at one terminal. Expand your business to multiple locations. Manage terminals in different cities, optimize parking, and connect your empire from coast to coast.
Terminal Master-Bus Tycoon provides a fun and engaging way to experience the challenges and rewards of managing a transportation business. Whether you’re dealing with the daily operations, upgrading your fleet, or expanding your empire, this game offers a unique and addictive experience that keeps you coming back for more.
So, what are you waiting for? Download Terminal Master-Bus Tycoon now and start building your transportation empire today! Serve the people, manage your business, and become the ultimate terminal master. With awesome adventures and endless opportunities for growth, this game is perfect for anyone looking for a new and exciting idle game experience.

The all-new JAL app is here!

A streamlined and simple design, crafted for everyone to understand. Smooth and effortless usability.

What you need, when you need it—the new JAL app is preparing for takeoff.

From discovering travel inspiration and exploring your destination to booking your flights and securing your seat, the JAL app handles it all.

bluejetty:00172391:ios.description:
The heart rate monitor will help you track your pulse, blood oxygen levels and blood pressure. 
Your history measurements will be saved and you can view detailed statistics. Also in our application you can find useful recipes and even meditation tracks. 
Increase your personal well-being by keeping track of your health data.
THE FULL PACKAGE OF BENEFITS TO INCREASE YOUR WELL-BEING:
√ Get your heart rate in 10 seconds
√ Capture and track blood oxygen and blood pressure values received from other devices.
√ Check your stress levels and your mood.
√ See trends and insights in easy-to-understand statistics
√ Individual reminder timer for pulse measurement
√ Unlimited data storage
√ Get access to meditations, delicious recipes, fitness tests and other suggestions for heart health.
WHAT TO DO AND HOW TO MEASURE THE HEART RATE:
This is how you get the best possible results:
* Try not to think about anything during the measurement. Do not talk and please keep calm to increase accuracy.
* Direct sunlight or a lamp could distort the readings - just stand in the shade. 
* Make sure your fingers are not too cold to avoid restricting blood flow in your finger.
* Place the tip of your index finger gently on the iPhone’s camera. Cover the entire camera. Tap 'start measurement'.
* The camera detects a color change in your finger tip each time your heart beats and the app uses an advanced algorithm to show you your heart rate.
* The app shows you the progress of the measurement and also when it has been completed.
* After a few seconds the measurement is finished.
* You can take further measurements immediately afterwards.
ABSOLUTE PRIVACY:
The Heart Rate Monitor app does not share any health data - all measurements you record remain on your device. 
We respect your privacy and believe that your health data belongs only to you.
We hope you enjoy this app!
DISCLAIMER:
Heart Rate Monitor app has been designed for informational and educational purposes only. 
The app is not intended to diagnose, prevent or treat any condition. Hence, it should not be considered as a substitute of a processional medical device.
Privacy Policy:
https://pepperbit.online/evo-tec-labs/heart-rate-monitor-privacy-policy/
Terms of Use:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00149608:ios.summary:
GiftYa The thought that counts! Let others know you are thinking of them when you send a GiftYa!
VIRTUAL GIFTS
Introducing GiftYa - the gift card app that allows you to send a gift card in a new way! From the makers of Giftcards.com,
bluejetty:00149608:ios.description:
GiftYa The thought that counts! Let others know you are thinking of them when you send a GiftYa!
VIRTUAL GIFTS
Introducing GiftYa - the gift card app that allows you to send a gift card in a new way! From the makers of Giftcards.com, GifYa is an app that completely streamlines and simplifies the gift card gift-giving process! We have reinvented gift sharing to be more accessible, personalized, and thoughtful than ever! Gift card apps are often hit-or-miss. You buy gift cards that either don’t work or get sent to the wrong email. With GiftYa, we've made an app that ensures these irritating problems will never happen to you again! Become the ultimate e-gifter with GiftYa!
The process is simple. Connect your credit/debit card to GiftYa, and you can purchase gift cards (a GiftYa) and send them through text messages to your friends and family! Sending gift cards via email can lead to mistakes in delivery - phone numbers are easier to enter accurately and are less cluttered with messages. They are also more accessible for any technologically challenged people in your life. Anyone can receive a text and claim their gift card. Granny won’t have to reset her email password just to get her birthday gift this year! When you send someone mobile gift cards with GiftYa, they can link it to their credit/debit card in seconds. Once someone purchases with their linked card, GiftYa credits their account until they’ve spent the total amount in their GiftYa gift card wallet! Redeem GiftYa’s ANYWHERE you can use your card!
That’s the best part! With this method, a GiftYa is usable at ANY business. Gift cards aren't just for major chains anymore! You can use GiftYa to send giftcards to Starbucks or that small cafe down the road serving your friend's favorite chai latte. GiftYa is even more widely accepted than a Visa card! It is just that convenient!
SIMPLE GIFTS
Any occasion is a good time for a gift. Gift for whatever, whenever. Before, people bought gift cards for holidays, birthdays, and other special occasions. Now, you can send a GiftYa for as little as $5. If It’s the thought that counts, then let people know you are thinking of them! Know someone going for a job interview, send them a $5 GiftYa for a cup of coffee with a personalized Good Luck message. Congratulate that new grad with a quick GiftYa for whatever graduation shenanigans they have planned! Send something clever or cute to your sweetheart in the middle of their day just to let them know you’re thinking of them! GiftYa makes your e-gifts a breeze! Make your GiftYa more meaningful when set and send personalized card photos - Or send a video with a message that shows how much you care.
HOW IT WORKS:
• Sending a GiftYa
Choose from almost any merchant, select the amount you want to give, personalize your GiftYa with a photo or video and send it to your recipient’s phone within seconds.
• Receiving a GiftYa
Link the GiftYa you received to your credit or debit card in seconds, purchase as you usually would, and your account is credited the amount you spend until the GiftYa is completely used.
GET STARTED
Get started with GiftYa and make the thought count!
GiftYa uses the technology that’s part of our everyday lives to send meaningful, personalized gifts in the moment. $1 billion in gift cards go unused every year. GiftYa fixes that by linking the gift to the recipient’s credit or debit card so the gift can’t be lost and doesn’t go unused. No more unused gift cards.
Love GiftYa?
Please take a moment to review our app! Your feedback is very important to us.
GiftYa | The thought that counts
DOWNLOAD GiftYa today and become the most thoughtful digital gifter the world has ever seen!

bluejetty:00066213:ios.summary:
Not in the mood for a night out? but could use a nice, calm game of tarneeb? now we've got just the thing for you!
With Pocket Tarneeb we’ll save you the hassle of dealing cards, and calculating the score by letting you play on your phone
bluejetty:00066213:ios.description:
Not in the mood for a night out? but could use a nice, calm game of tarneeb? now we've got just the thing for you!
With Pocket Tarneeb we’ll save you the hassle of dealing cards, and calculating the score by letting you play on your phone or tablet, but with a lot of extra features of our own:
- Play Tarneeb with multiple score limits (31, 41 or 61) and multiple game modes (Egyptian (Red & Black, Syrian or Normal Tarneeb)
- Online Multiplayer
- LAN Multiplayer
- A very easy and helpful in-game tutorial for Tarneeb newcomers
- Play Pocket Tarneeb against a challenging AI in an offline single player mode
- Auto-save your Tarneeb games in order to continue them later if not completed
- Control your game speed in single player mode
- Track your progress in Pocket Tarneeb through the Profile menu
- Play and earn XP to level up and show off your progress
- Various challenging achievements to unlock
- Buy and collect a variety of creative card decks and backgrounds from the in-game store
- Create your own avatar with hundreds of unique and funny looks (for both male and female) for other people to see
- Personalize your game theme by setting any colour you desire using the RGB colour picker
- Taunt other players by performing multiple, funny in-game actions
- Use funny clips and memes to express your feelings
- Pocket Tarneeb Supports Arabic, English and ‘Franco’ Arabic
Terms and Conditions: https://www.fanellaproductions.com/terms-conditions

bluejetty:00178340:ios.name: Watch Faces & Widget Gallery
bluejetty:00178340:ios.summary:
Give your Apple Watch a look that's all you. With more than 2,000 watch faces, from wallpapers to complications, Watch Faces & Widget Gallery lets you match your watch to your style, your day, and your mood.
Browse collections curated by t
bluejetty:00178340:ios.description:
Give your Apple Watch a look that's all you. With more than 2,000 watch faces, from wallpapers to complications, Watch Faces & Widget Gallery lets you match your watch to your style, your day, and your mood.
Browse collections curated by theme and loved by Apple Watch fans, preview every detail, and add the face that feels like you in a few taps.
And now, adding a face is smoother and more reliable than ever. Here's what you can add:
• Complication faces: Built on Modular, Modular Duo, Modular Ultra, Infograph, and Meridian, they show live info such as activity, steps, heart rate, weather, and the date. Requires PRO.
• Wallpaper faces: Built on the Photos watch face, they fill your display with a design you love. Many are free, and premium designs require PRO.
• Complications and widgets: Add our complications to your watch faces and our widgets to the Smart Stack on Apple Watch.
Whether you want something bold for the weekend, clean for the office, or sporty for your next run, you'll find a face that fits.
Why Watch Faces & Widget Gallery?
• More than a wallpaper. Complication faces are complete watch faces with live info, while wallpaper faces set a design behind the time.
• Know before you add. Every preview shows which Apple Watch models a face works with.
• Always something new. Fresh faces arrive regularly, so your watch can change as often as you do.
• Free to start. Download, browse, and add many wallpaper faces for free.
Requires iPhone with iOS 17 or later and Apple Watch with watchOS 10 or later. With your permission, some complications use Health, location, and calendar data.
If you love Watch Faces & Widget Gallery, try PRO. Unlock every complication face and premium wallpaper with a weekly, monthly, or yearly subscription.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at purchase, or when a free trial ends. Your subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial, if offered, is forfeited when you subscribe.
Privacy Policy: https://watchfaces.co/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://watchfaces.co/terms-and-conditions/
Contact: https://watchfaces.co/contact/

Sleep Sounds & Frequencies is designed to help you fall asleep faster, reduce stress, and create a peaceful environment anytime, anywhere. Whether you're dealing with insomnia, trying to relax, or looking to focus, our app provides the perfect sound experience.
**Sleep Sounds for Better Rest**
Enjoy a wide range of white noise, rain, ocean waves, and nature sounds that help you block distractions and drift into deep sleep naturally.
**Healing Frequencies & Sound Therapy**
Explore popular tones like 432Hz and 528Hz, often used for relaxation, meditation, and emotional balance. Let calming frequencies support your daily wellness routine.
**Relax, Focus & Recharge**
Use ambient sounds and binaural beats to improve concentration, reduce mental fatigue, and create a calm state of mind for work, study, or meditation.
**Key Features**
• White noise, rain, ocean & nature sounds
• Healing frequencies: 432Hz, 528Hz & more
• Binaural beats for focus & relaxation
• Sleep timer for automatic stop
• Create your own sound mix
• Save your favorite sounds
**Designed for Everyday Calm**
Perfect for sleep, relaxation, meditation, and focus—anytime you need a moment of peace.
**Popular Frequencies**
• 432Hz – commonly used for relaxation
• 528Hz – often associated with positive energy
• 396Hz – used in calming meditation practices
• 417Hz – linked to renewal and change
• 639Hz – supports emotional awareness
• 741Hz – used in mindfulness sessions
• 852Hz – associated with intuition

◆ Master your accent with the Speech Studio. Simply record yourself say
bluejetty:00120412:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch into your FAVORITE teacher of Norwegian.
◆ The most essential words and phrases of the language, each with native speaker audio. 
◆ Master your accent with the Speech Studio. Simply record yourself saying a phrase and then hear your voice next to the teacher’s. You’ll be AMAZED how quickly your foreign accent melts away.
◆ All audio is downloaded to the device and accessible even in airplane mode or without expensive international roaming fees.
◆ Nemo is NOT BUILT AROUND LESSONS at all. It is meant to be picked up and put down throughout the day, whenever you have a few minutes to spare.
◆ Builds a foundation of Norwegian empowering you to speak CONFIDENTLY in EVERYDAY CONVERSATIONS. 
◆ NO PRIOR KNOWLEDGE of Norwegian required.
Nemo® is specially DESIGNED to tap the remarkable power of your mobile device, and your brain, to their fullest. 
PERSONALIZED FOR YOU
Nemo is your personal trainer, tracking your PROGRESS across every single word and phrase.
◆ Practice Norwegian the way you'll use it. Nemo is fully customizable.
◆ Nemo immerses you in the sounds of Norwegian so you naturally speak with ease.
◆ Dive into WHAT YOU WANT to learn at any time.
◆ You control which words to practice – skip words you don’t want to learn or already know.
◆ Turn on Review Mode to study what you practiced earlier in the day to BOOST your memory retention.
◆ Hear English descriptions of all words, in a flashcard format.
◆ Quiz your mastery of the vocabulary.
◆ Nemo introduces words to you progressively to develop familiarity and reviews them at the right moment so they enter your LONG TERM MEMORY.
TARGET THE MOST COMMON WORDS
Maximize your time investment by targeting the most basic and high frequency words of the language.
Upgrade to the complete version to:
◆ Get off the beaten path or find comfort with DIRECTIONS, TRAVEL and HOTEL phrases.
◆ Decode menus with the most common FOOD words.
◆ Shop and find bargains like an insider with must-know SHOPPING phrases.
◆ Learn words useful for your time in norway.
◆ Build your proficiency with the most important verbs and SENTENCE BUILDING BLOCKS in Norwegian.
◆ Spark new friendships with COMPLIMENTS and CONVERSATION STARTERS.
Use your new skills to make friends, impress old friends, bring smiles to children, get out of jams, experience new things, speak confidently, and make your travel and cultural experience more rich and fulfilling.
Download this FREE app now!

bluejetty:00091883:ios.description:
Better Banks is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Better Banks:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Better Banks app, you must be enrolled as a Better Banks digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00082913:ios.name: Bitdefender SecurePass
bluejetty:00082913:ios.summary: Stay safe online with Bitdefender SecurePass, a top-tier password manager built for those who take security seriously. Powered by advanced end-to-end encryption technology, SecurePass protects your passwords, credit card details, and sensit
bluejetty:00082913:ios.description:
Stay safe online with Bitdefender SecurePass, a top-tier password manager built for those who take security seriously. Powered by advanced end-to-end encryption technology, SecurePass protects your passwords, credit card details, and sensitive information across all your devices. Whether you manage hundreds of accounts or just a few, SecurePass takes the hassle out of remembering passwords and gives you vault-like security.
Key Features:
• Complete Protection: Secure your passwords and sensitive data with end-to-end encryption, keeping your online accounts and personal information completely private.
• Password Generator & Strength Advisor: Create strong, complex passwords with just one click. Use the built-in advisor to check if any of your existing passwords are weak or require attention.
• Multi-platform Synchronization: Save and sync your passwords across multiple platforms. Access your password manager vault anytime, anywhere.
• Master Password Convenience: Manage all your accounts with just one Master Password. SecurePass eliminates the need to remember dozens of login details by centralizing everything in one secure password manager.
Secure Credit Card Management: Protect your payment details for online shopping. Autofill your credit card information on websites safely, knowing that your sensitive data is encrypted and stored locally on your device.
• Easy Import/Export: Transitioning from another password manager? SecurePass makes it easy to import your data from 1Password, Dashlane, LastPass, Chrome, Firefox, and more. Supported file formats include JSON, CSV, and XML.
• Share Passwords Safely: Need to share passwords with family or colleagues? Use SecurePass to share credentials securely, thanks to encrypted password sharing.
• Password Leak Alerts: SecurePass constantly monitors data breaches to alert you if any of your credentials are exposed, giving you a chance to update your passwords before it’s too late.
Additional Features:
 • Two-Factor Authentication: Add an extra layer of security to your password vault.
 • Secure Notes: Store sensitive information like documents, personal notes, or PIN codes with color-coded organization.
 • Identities Management: Manage multiple online identities with ease, autofilling your details for fast form completion.
 • Auto-Lock & Secure Me Feature: Automatically log out or lock your vault after inactivity or on shared devices.
 • Face & Fingerprint Unlock: Quickly access your vault with biometric authentication on supported devices.
Why Choose Bitdefender SecurePass?
Bitdefender SecurePass is designed for users who value privacy and need top-tier protection for their online identities. As a powerful and intuitive password manager, SecurePass offers a seamless way to manage your digital life without compromising on security. Whether you’re shopping online, managing work accounts, or simply keeping track of personal passwords, SecurePass has your back.
Please note: a paid subscription is required to use this app.
Subscription Agreement - https://www.bitdefender.com/site/view/subscription-agreement.html
Privacy Policy - https://www.bitdefender.com/site/view/legal-privacy-policy-for-home-users-solutions.html

bluejetty:00115600:ios.summary:
Screen Share App: Smart Way to View and Cast from Phone to TV
Turn your phone into a powerful screen sharing tool. With Screen Mirroring, you can wirelessly connect your device to any smart TV, mirror your entire screen, or cast videos, ph
bluejetty:00115600:ios.description:
Screen Share App: Smart Way to View and Cast from Phone to TV
Turn your phone into a powerful screen sharing tool. With Screen Mirroring, you can wirelessly connect your device to any smart TV, mirror your entire screen, or cast videos, photos, games, and more — all in just a few taps. No cables, no complicated setup, and no extra hardware needed.
Screen Mirroring is the easiest way to share your screen in real time, whether enjoying a movie night, showing a presentation, or making a video call.
How to Use:
1. Make sure your phone and TV are connected to the same WiFi network.
2. Open Screen Mirroring and choose your smart TV or streaming device from the list.
3. Pick what you want to share — your screen, videos, photos, or apps — and start casting.
Key Features:
Mirror Phone Screen to TV
 Wirelessly project your phone screen onto your TV in real-time — great for games, chats, or browsing.
Cast Videos & Photos
 Instantly cast your favorite videos, movies, and photos from your phone gallery or the web to the TV.
Stream Content from the Web
 Browse and stream videos directly from websites and watch them on a larger screen.
Share Documents & Presentations
 View PDF, PPT, and other docs on your TV for easier group sharing and collaboration.
Play Games on the Big Screen
 Turn your TV into a gaming display by mirroring your gameplay in real-time.
Big-Screen Video Calls
 Enhance your video call experience by connecting your phone to your TV and seeing everyone on a bigger screen.
Easy IPTV Support
 Use the built-in IPTV player to access your favorite streaming services.
Compatibility:
- Works with all major smart TVs: Samsung, LG, Sony, TCL, Hisense, and more
- Supports popular streaming devices: Chromecast, Roku, Fire TV, and Apple TV
- Requires no additional hardware or software
Why Choose Screen Share App?
- Fast and stable screen sharing without delays
- Seamless TV connection via WiFi
- Cast everything from your phone — videos, photos, games, documents
- User-friendly interface that anyone can use
- Ideal for both home entertainment and business purposes
Screen Share App is your all-in-one smart cast tool to transform any screen into a wireless projector. Connect your phone, mirror your screen, and enjoy smooth streaming experiences across devices.
We Value Your Feedback
Have suggestions or issues? Our team is here to help improve your mirroring, casting, and streaming experience. Let us know how we can serve you better!
We share anonymized app usage data with Apple for security and refund fraud prevention. Our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use contain our complete refund policy.

bluejetty:00182766:ios.description:
Miss classic social RPGs from the early Facebook era, where strategy, patience, and reputation mattered more than flashy graphics? Mob Wars is still here and still growing.
Over 1 million registered players. Online since 2009. Available on iOS, Facebook, and web.
Welcome to Mob Wars: La Cosa Nostra, the original online text-based mafia RPG. Step into a massive multiplayer underworld where you compete in PvP battles against real players, build your mob, and rise through the ranks of a living criminal empire.
You start with nothing. No money. No respect. No crew.
Work your way up by completing gang missions, earning cash, managing businesses, and growing your mob as you compete with real players in an online mafia world where every decision matters.
Mob Wars delivers the deep social gameplay that fans of classic browser mafia games remember, combining long-term progression, multiplayer competition, and strategic decision-making.
Build your gang, expand your empire, and dominate rival families in a world driven by real player interaction.
Unlike many mafia games, Mob Wars is built around social gameplay. Chat with players, form alliances, recruit mobsters, and create powerful syndicates. Choose your allies carefully. Loyalty is everything.
But watch your back. Mafia wars can break out at any time. When rival gangs strike, you will need your crew and syndicate to survive gang wars, hitlist attacks, and large-scale PvP battles.
PVP BATTLES & SYNDICATE WARS
▶ Fight real players in competitive PvP combat
▶ Join syndicates and dominate syndicate wars

bluejetty:00177173:ios.description:
Fireworks Play: The Ultimate 3D Fireworks Simulator. Do you love fireworks? Do you want to create your own spectacular shows? Do you want to have fun with explosive items and props? Then Fireworks Play is the game for you!
Fireworks Play is a realistic and immersive 3D simulator game that lets you experience the thrill of shooting fireworks.
----- Game Statements -----
* No coins, no tickets, and no loot boxes
* No ads every minute
* All items are available to play right away
Fireworks Play: The Ultimate 3D Fireworks Simulator. Do you love fireworks? Want to create your own spectacular shows? Enjoy fun with explosive items and props? Then Fireworks Play is for you!
Fireworks Play is a realistic 3D simulator game that lets you experience the thrill of shooting fireworks.
------ Outstanding features -----
* Run and shoot fireworks worldwide
* Explore maps: Town, West, Samurai, Horror Mansion, and more
* Build shows with sets, shells, cakes, racks, and more
* Customize fireworks with colors, heights, times, trails, sizes, angles, and sounds
* Experiment with gas tanks, grenades, TNT, and powder
* Use guns, planes, helicopters, torches, and props
* Save, load, and share your creations
* Enjoy stunning graphics, sound effects, and music
* Multiplayer Fun: Team up or compete with friends in real-time! Create epic shows or cause explosive chaos—watch out, lighting TNT or gas tanks might blast your pals!
----- Outstanding fireworks and items -----
* Customizable shells & cakes.
* Shell Types: Brocade, Chrysanthemum, Classic, Crossette, Dahlia, Ghost Shell, Horsetail, Strobe, Salute, Willow, Comet, Fountain, Mine.
* Explosion: Gas Tank, Grenade, Bomb, Smoke.
* Firecrackers, Racks.
* Special: Nuke Craft, Jump Shoes, Strong Hand, Binoculars, Revolver, Shotgun, Cowboy Rifle, Flare Gun, Flamethrower, RPG Firework, Sheet Machine, Target Stand, Magic Ice, Light Plane, Helicopter, Firing Module, Reloadable Tube, Magic Tube, Firework Spawning Wand, Real Christmas Air Balloon, Mortar Cannon.
* Props: Torch, Candle, Snow Man, Christmas Tree, Music Box, Speaker, Thin Sparkler Candle, Sky Lantern, Traffic Cone, Kwitis Stand, Confetti Cannon, Dual Spinner, Spray Machine, Confetti Shooter, Smoke Flare, Ground Strobe, Air Smoke Bomb.
* Rewards: Thor Thunder, Smoking Pumpkin, Teddy Bear, Military Mortar, Umbrella, UFO Spinner, Minigun Candle, Battery, Monster Firecracker, Gold Shining, Hwacha, Umbrella Fountain, Swimming Stars, Mini Sky Shot, Mini Cake, God of Salute, Crackling Sliver, Kwitis Barrage, Rain of Fire, Super Toy Car, Air Defense, DMX Fire Machine, Military Rocket, Twister Drone, Sparkle Wheel, Girandola, Anti Venom, Multi Flame Machine, Smoky Twister, Airframe Missile.
----- An open-world, variety of mini-games -----
* Online Football Game: Soccer Stadium for multiplayer free-kick face-offs with a fiery wrecking ball challenge.
* Quick Draw Cowboy Gun: Test your speed and accuracy in wild west duels.
* Crafting Nuclear Bomb: Survive and build a nuke with puzzles in a doomed city.
* Break into Horror Mansion Puzzle: Fit blocks to enter the creepy mansion this Halloween.
* Driving Hot Air Balloon: Fly over cities, play with fireworks, or blow things up.
* Building Destruction: Compete to demolish buildings on various maps.
* Flying Helicopter: Pilot missions with fireworks and shells, requiring skill.
* Clay Hunt: Enjoy clay pigeon shooting with fireworks twists.
Fireworks Play is the ultimate fireworks game for all ages and occasions. Celebrate holidays, birthdays, or just have fun with friends—Fireworks Play delivers an unforgettable experience!

bluejetty:00022752:ios.description:
Haberler.com, sizi dünyanın nabzını tutmaya davet ediyor! Her gün milyonlarca insanın hayatını etkileyen güncel olayları takip etmek artık çok daha kolay. Uygulamamız, geniş ve güçlü editör ve muhabir kadrosuyla, en son haberleri anında size ulaştırıyor.
Ekonomiden siyasete, teknolojiden sağlığa, spor ve kültür dünyasına kadar geniş bir yelpazede haberleri keşfedin.
Ayrıca, Yerel Haberler bölümüyle bulunduğunuz şehirdeki önemli olaylardan da haberdar olun. Bu bilgiyi sadece o şehirdeki insanlara özel bildirimlerle doğrudan telefonlarına iletiriz.
Neden Haberler.com Uygulaması?
- Güvenilir Haber: Tarafsız ve güvenilir haber akışı ile Türkiye’de ve Dünya’da olan olaylar ile ilgili doğru bilgi edinin.
- Kişiselleştirilmiş Deneyim: İlgi alanlarınıza ve tercihlerinize göre özelleştirilmiş bir haber akışıyla her gün en önemli gelişmeleri öğrenin.
- Canlı Bildirimler: Önemli gelişmeler olduğunda anında haberdar olun. Canlı bildirimlerle kritik olayları kaçırmayın.
- Mobil Uyumlu: İster evde, ister işte, ister seyahatte olun, haberlere her zaman ve her yerde erişim sağlayın.
Uygulamamızda 50 ’den fazla kategoride haber sunmaktayız. İşte bunlardan bazıları:
- Haberler: Dünya genelinden en son haberler ve gelişmeler.
- Ekonomi: Piyasaların güncel durumu, finansal analizler ve iş dünyasına dair önemli bilgiler.
- Siyaset / Politika: Ulusal ve uluslararası siyasi gelişmeler, liderlerin açıklamaları ve analizler.
- Teknoloji: Yenilikçi teknolojiler, dijital trendler ve teknoloji dünyasındaki en son haberler.
- Sağlık: Sağlık bilimleri, tıp alanındaki yeni keşifler, sağlık trendleri ve yaşam tarzı ipuçları.
- Spor: Futbol, basketbol, tenis ve daha birçok spor dalında en son skorlar, transferler ve maç analizleri.
- Kültür ve Sanat: Sanat, sinema, edebiyat ve popüler kültür hakkında güncel haberler ve eleştiriler.
- Analiz: Uzmanlarımızın derinlemesine analizleri ve yorumlarıyla olayları daha iyi anlayın.
- Haber uygulamamız ile dünyayı keşfedin, yerelde ve küreselde güncel kalmak için hiçbir şeyi kaçırmayın! İndirin ve haberlerin dünyasına adım atın.

bluejetty:00185684:ios.name: Cow Evolution: Merge to Evolve
bluejetty:00185684:ios.summary: Become the biggest animal farmer in Cow Evolution! Merge cows and discover amazing new mutant creatures. Collect coins and crystals, upgrade your equipment and become an animal farm tycoon. Play Cow Evolution for FREE* now and discover all
bluejetty:00185684:ios.description:
Become the biggest animal farmer in Cow Evolution! Merge cows and discover amazing new mutant creatures. Collect coins and crystals, upgrade your equipment and become an animal farm tycoon. Play Cow Evolution for FREE* now and discover all the mysterious species!
Everything on the farm was just cows when mutations and evolutions started to create amazing creatures! Merge the animals and build a farm with a variety of mutated monsters. You can also customize your animals with various items such as hats, clothes, and accessories, and discover other worlds with mysterious creature species.
IDLE CLICKER GAME
Tap and collect resources to evolve your cow farm. There are hundreds of items for you to collect, with discoveries that can lead you to discover more mutant cow species and ensure your progress through the game. Level up your farm, customize your cows with hats, clothes, and accessories, and share the creatures you've discovered with your friends.
MERGE COW SPECIES
There are three main stages in this animal evolution simulator: monster cows, alpaca cows, and alien cows. Test different combinations between these three stages and expand the number of mutant creatures on your farm. The more discoveries you make, the more cows and items you earn to increase your catalog of discovered species and expand the monsters on your farm.
ANIMAL MUTANT FARM
Put on your farmer outfit and start taking care of your mutant cows. Complete the main quests of the idle clicker game and earn items to customize your animals. There are many options of hats, hair, clothes, and accessories to make your farm much more fun. Remember to play every day to collect more coins and crystals, and share your farm with your friends.
*Cow Evolution is a free idle merge clicker game. However, it has additional features and extra items that can be purchased in the in-game store.

Become Agent 47, the ultimate stealth assassin.
Travel to massive sandbox locations full of opportunities, from exquisite palais in Paris to beautiful coastal town of Italy to complete your contracts.
Play the ICA Training Facility missions (tutorial) and Sebastian Principle Escalation in Dubai for free. Unlock additional content in the app.

Optimized for mobile. Controller supported. Keyboard and mouse not supported.
HITMAN World of Assassination full application is approximately 48GB.
Important Note: The installation process requires that you have at least twice the size of the application in free storage space available. We recommend downloading the data in an environment with good connectivity.
Estimated download time based on connection speed:
- 10 Mbps - Over 6 hours
- 100 Mbps - 30 to 40 minutes
- 3000 Mbps - 8 - 10 minutes
Each Location varies between ~2-4 GB, excluding shared game data. Locations can be downloaded, installed or deleted separately.
This is managed in the “Store” menu, select the Location and “Delete Game Data”, at the bottom left of the screen.

bluejetty:00126033:ios.description:

تطبيقنا مصمم خصيصًا للأطفال الناطقين بالعربية، لمساعدتهم على تحسين السلوك والتفاعل مع رسائل توجيهية ممتعة من الشرطة.
مناسب لجميع الدول التي يتواجد بها أطفال يتحدثون العربية.
تطبيق “شرطة الأطفال الجديدة” هو وسيلة تربوية مبتكرة تساعد الأهل على تشجيع السلوك الحسن وتحسين العادات اليومية لدى الأطفال بطريقة محببة وفعالة.
من خلال مكالمات وهمية مرحة مع الشرطي، يمكن:
•تحفيز الطفل عند القيام بتصرف جيد
• تنبيهه بلطف عند التصرف غير اللائق
• تذكيره بالنوم، تناول الطعام، الدراسة، النظافة، وغيرها من العادات الصحية 
مميزات التطبيق:
• أصوات حقيقية وودية تناسب عمر الطفل
• واجهة بسيطة وسهلة الاستخدام
• أقسام متعددة: شرطة البنات وشرطة الأولاد
• إشعارات ذكية تشجع على الروتين الإيجابي
• لا حاجة للإنترنت بعد التثبيت
• خالٍ من أي محتوى مخيف أو غير مناسب
ملاحظة هامة:
تم تصميم هذا التطبيق ليُستخدم كوسيلة دعم تربوي إيجابية، وليس للترهيب أو التخويف.
ينصح باستخدامه دائمًا بأسلوب حنون وواعٍ لتعزيز الثقة والعلاقة بين الطفل وأهله.
Child Police – A Smart Tool for Positive Parenting
This app is designed especially for Arabic-speaking children to help guide behavior through friendly and engaging police-themed messages.
It’s ideal for families in any country where Arabic is spoken at home.
Child Police is an educational app that helps parents encourage good habits and correct behavior in a fun and effective way.
With playful pretend phone calls from the police officer, children can:
• Be rewarded for positive behavior
• Be gently reminded when misbehaving
• Be encouraged to sleep, eat, study, or maintain hygiene and daily routines
Key Features:
• Friendly, realistic voices suitable for young children
• Simple and intuitive interface
• Dedicated modes: Boys Police and Girls Police
• Smart notifications to support positive routines
• No internet required after installation
• Completely safe and free from scary or inappropriate content
Important Note:
This app is designed as a positive educational support tool, not for intimidation.
Parents are advised to use it with warmth and awareness to strengthen trust and the parent-child relationship.

bluejetty:00123849:ios.name: Dope Wars (Weed Edition)
bluejetty:00123849:ios.summary: The good news - you have $2,000 in cash, and licenses to legally trade. The bad? You owe $5,500 to Dishonest Harry, a not-too-friendly loan shark, interest is piling up, he'll be visiting you soon for his money, and he owns a chainsaw! Just
bluejetty:00123849:ios.description:
The good news - you have $2,000 in cash, and licenses to legally trade. The bad? You owe $5,500 to Dishonest Harry, a not-too-friendly loan shark, interest is piling up, he'll be visiting you soon for his money, and he owns a chainsaw! Just sayin'. You only have one choice - dive into the world of wholesale trading of weed to make money fast and save your skin!
As you travel from location to location, a day passes and local prices change. Buy low, sell higher! But beware - Officer Hardass is looking out for you, so get prepared for a stand-off with the cops by visiting the Dope Wars Store to tool up for the inevitable confrontation! You can also buy more storage space along the way at the Store, so look out for sales and special offers.
Along the way, special market events will cause prices to rise or fall spectacularly, so be ready for these, this is how you get rich! There are muggers out there, so try to keep unused cash in the bank, earning interest. Other loan sharks can lend you money to solve short-term liquidity crunches, but they'll be after their money soon enough! If you get injured, pop in to see the local doctor at his surgery, but look out - he has no scruples, and you have kidneys. A bad combination.
Listen out for the crazy old lady, too. She sure has some wacky things to say, but occasionally, she'll give you a very handy tip off, which is essential to your financial success in Dope Wars. Also, keep an eye out (and cash on hand) for the chance to buy a larger coat. More space, more profit! Good luck my friend, you're sure going to need it!!
This is the full paid version. This version is ad-free, allows 15, 60, 90, 120 and 365 day game lengths for turn-based games and 1, 5, 10, 15 and 20 minutes for timed games, shows arrows indicating direction of daily price changes, and adds the powerful RCL 9000 weapon. There is also the ad-supported free-version available, with ads and the 30 day and 2minute game length options.
This version of Dope Wars is ported directly from the wildly popular version of the PC game, also from Beermat Software. Same great addictive game play, modified for your mobile device!
If you find any bugs in Dope Wars , or would like to see new features added to Dope Wars, please drop us an email at beermatsoftware.@gmail.com

Cook and serve delicious food around the world in a time management cooking game!
Step into Kitchen Craze, a dynamic cooking game where time management and quick food servings are crucial in worldwide restaurants.
Kitchen Craze offers a fast-paced culinary experience in the heart of the city. Each level introduces new dishes and unique challenges, requiring quick thinking and efficient time management to manage the restaurant madness.
As orders mount, your skills in quick cooking and serving are essential. Each new level in this cooking mania challenges you to be quicker and more precise, intensifying the culinary fever.
Travel the globe in Kitchen Craze, serving from street stalls to upscale restaurants. Each setting on this journey tests your evolution from an aspiring chef to a Master, showcasing a variety of cuisine. Participate in live events, where chefs compete solo or in teams, adding an exciting competitive edge.
How to Play the Game: -
In Kitchen Craze, efficiently serve customers before they dash off. Manage your time effectively, preparing a variety of dishes, and keep your diners satisfied. As you progress, unlock kitchen upgrades and face increasingly demanding customers in this restaurant game.
Game Features: -
→ Master your culinary skills through 1100+ levels across 8 global restaurants in this fast-paced cooking simulator.
→ Team up with friends to collect lives, earn coins, and top the leaderboards.
→ Engage in challenges, showcasing your speed and skill in various events.
→ Upgrade your kitchen equipment in the diner to master advanced dishes and boost efficiency.
→ Enhance your kitchen for more efficient service, with helpful boosters to ease your tasks.
→ Complete daily tasks for rewards, keeping customers happy and expanding your empire.
→ Join or create teams, connecting with chefs worldwide.
→ Enjoy delicious food serving in online mode, perfect for playing anytime, anywhere. 
→ Kitchen Craze 2026 is a hit among games for adults, offering fun for all ages.
Join the thrilling world of Kitchen Craze, where every meal brings you closer to fame. This game blends the excitement of the restaurant world with time management, turning every dish into a thrilling race.
Ready to embrace the kitchen challenge? Jump into Kitchen Craze, serve up mouth-watering dishes, and rise to become a master chef in this captivating cooking game.

Welcome to Eatr - the ultimate companion for everyone from cooking novices to seasoned chefs! 
Our app is designed to guide you through a culinary adventure tailored just for you. Whether you're pressed for time or looking to indulge in a leisurely cooking spree, Eatr has you covered.
Time Management in Your Kitchen:
Choose your cooking time - from quick 15-minute bites to sumptuous meals under an hour - and let Eatr plan your menu. Busy schedules have met their match with our smart, time-conscious recipes.
Get Inspired:
Dive into thousands of mouth-watering recipes. With Eatr, discover daily inspiration and never run out of ideas for your next meal.
Personalized Skills Journey:
Whether you’re just starting out or are a kitchen pro, Eatr grows with you. Select your skill level and get recipes that challenge and excite you, all the while expanding your culinary prowess.
Dietary Preferences? We Listen:
Keto? Vegan? Pescatarian? No matter your diet, Eatr offers personalized recommendations to keep you aligned with your lifestyle choices. Sticking to your diet was never this effortless or delightful.
Powerful Filters for Tailored Search:
With robust search filters for cuisine, diet, meal type, and more, find exactly what you fancy with just a few taps.
Ratings and Feedback:
Be part of a community where your opinion matters. Rate recipes, helping others and yourself to the best-tasting dishes.
Nutritional Insight:
Stay informed with detailed nutritional information for each recipe, ensuring you meet your health and fitness goals.
Easy Cooking with Step-by-Step Guides:
Clear, concise, and easy-to-follow instructions take the guesswork out of cooking. Enjoy the process as much as the result!

Download our app now and make your birthday an unforgettable celebration. Surprise your friends and family with fun personalized birthday videos and become the star of your special day!

Our birthday greetings app also features a video maker that allows you to edit and customize birthday videos for your friends and family. You can add fun music and special effects to make your videos even more entertaining and memorable.
Additionally, our birthday app is perfect for children's celebrations as it features animated cards and birthday videos. And if you want, you can decorate your cards and videos with children's frames and montages to make them even more fun.
Don't worry about the watermark, as you can remove it from your creations. And if you want to make changes to your cards and videos after creating them, you can edit them as many times as you like.
Our birthday greetings app is the perfect solution for creating special and happy moments on the birthdays of your friends and family. Download our app now and surprise your loved ones with a unique and personalized greeting on their special day. Make their birthday even happier with our free and fun birthday app!

bluejetty:00040210:ios.description:
Welcome to Norse Runes, a modern app for anyone seeking to learn about Nordic culture and attain runic knowledge.
It's time to dive into the rich world of Norse culture, mythology, and the power of the runes!
-- Features at a glance:
* Gain daily insights with personalized daily rune readings.
* Read and learn about Havamal, a collection of Norse poems, filled with lessons for life.
* Explore the cultural and spiritual significance of Norse mythology.
* Use runes in spells and rituals for real-world applications.
* Translate and write in runic language. 
* Create runic formulas for all aspects of life. 
-- Comprehensive Rune Knowledge Base
Norse Runes isn't just about divination; it's your all-in-one resource for understanding and mastering runes. Whether you are a complete beginner or an experienced Vitkar, our knowledge base will guide and empower you. Learn about:
* Detailed Rune Meanings: Access in-depth explanations of each rune, its symbolism, and its magical significance.
* Practical Rune Usage: Understand how to apply runes in your daily life, from divination to rituals and charms.
* Runic Aettir and Futharks: Explore the three Aetts of the Elder Futhark and learn about the progression of runes in the Younger and Anglo-Saxon Futharks. 
-- Additional Features for Rune Enthusiasts
* Rune Translator: Effortlessly translate modern text into runic script and back. Perfect for adding an ancient touch to your writings or crafts.
* Runic Formula Generator: Need a specific runic formula for protection, love, career success, or health? Our unique generator crafts runic formulas tailored to your desires.
* Runic Knowledge and Learning: Gain insights into how runes are used today and in historical contexts, including magical and divinatory practices. 
-- Personalized AI Rune Divination
Experience the most personal and tailored rune readings available, guided by our advanced AI. 
Norse Runes is designed to connect deeply with your unique energy, providing you with personal and accurate insights to navigate your life's journey. 
You can explore a variety of rune divination methods, including:
* Daily Rune Reading: Begin each day with guidance and clarity.
* Simple Question Reading: Ask a specific question and receive a direct answer.
* Past, Present, Future Spread: Uncover the influences from your past, insights for your present, and guidance for your future.
* Complex Rune Spreads: Delve deeper into your life's challenges and direction with layouts like the Runic Compass, Runic Cross, and Overcoming Obstacles spread. 
-- Explore Norse and Viking Culture
Immerse yourself in the fascinating world of Norse mythology and Viking heritage. Our app features well-researched content on:
* Norse Gods and Mythology: Delve into the legends of Odin, Thor, Freya, and the entire Norse pantheon.
* Havamal Poem and Poetic Edda: Read ancient texts and gain wisdom from the Havamal and other key writings.
* Codex Regius and Historical Sources: Study the origins and historical uses of runes in Norse society. 
-- Rune Use in Witchcraft and Pagan Practices
Discover how runes are integrated into Celtic, pagan, occult, and Wiccan traditions. Our app provides guidance on:
* Charm and Spell Crafting: Use runes in protection spells, manifestation rituals, and more.
* Runic Bind Runes and Formulas: Learn how to combine runes into powerful symbols for specific intentions. 
-- Perfect for All Levels
Whether you are new to runes or a seasoned practitioner, Norse Runes is your guide to unlocking the hidden knowledge of the ancient Norse. Our app is designed to be intuitive and engaging, making the wisdom of the runes accessible to all. 
Download Norse Runes today and embark on a journey of self-discovery and ancient wisdom!
Privacy Policy: https://norserunes.web.app/privacy-policy
Terms Of Use: https://norserunes.web.app/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00042714:ios.summary: New App My SmartBike, by MAHLE, provides you an enhanced e-bike riding experience by using your smartphone as the interface to your bicycle. Our application is designed to help tune, customize e-bike performance and enjoy your trips. Connec
bluejetty:00042714:ios.description:
New App My SmartBike, by MAHLE, provides you an enhanced e-bike riding experience by using your smartphone as the interface to your bicycle. Our application is designed to help tune, customize e-bike performance and enjoy your trips. Connect with your e-bike and adjust your preferences, customize motor maps to adapt the MAHLE SmartBike System to your personal necessities, remaining batteries, record your activities, have access to statistics, see bike location and more. 
If you need detailed information and a dynamic experience, our web app (www.my-smartbike.com) enables you to analyze the routes in detail and graphically comparing data as elevation, health-related data and exclusive metrics from e-bikes, the tour on maps and share it through third platforms.
Functionality:
Always linked. 
Connect quickly with a new e-bike or a previously connected e-bike card.
Tune your ride. 
Configure motor maps of your e-bike, for each assistance level, to always get you the right level of power from your motor.
Be fun and start an activity. 
Are you ready? Start an activity and you will see all the information you need like instant speed, level of assistance, remaining battery, time and distance…and more. Once finished, view extended information about your recorded activities directly on the App or through a web browser. 
See even more on the Web. 
On the web, you will analyze your trip with a lot of information and amazing dashboards.
Know your Range Extender. 
The new range extender screen now shows the battery status, battery consumption, range, and assistance information. 
Get Monthly perspective on your rides. 
Add and see all your rides in a calendar view. 
Find your bike.
With the new functionality you can find the location where your electric bicycle was last seen.
Follow your heart. 
You can now pair a heart rate band and activate the special assistance mode, where system assistance adapts automatically depending on your heart rate. 
Share your ride. 
Upload automatically your ride to Strava. 
Keep your privacy. 
Protect your app with biometric authentication such as Face ID or fingerprint detection and also define your private areas (home, garage, office) to protect last mile information if you make your activity public.
Ride in dark mode with ease. 
New app will automatically switch to dark mode to match your phones presets.
Help Center
A library of videos to help you out with the MAHLE SmartBike App. View step by step instructions for most important App features.
Compatibility
Your e-bike must be compatible with the MAHLE SmartBike Bluetooth® platform.
* Continued use of GPS in the background can decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00140012:ios.description:
Your Complete Cruise Companion
Track any cruise ship across the globe in real-time. CruiseKick puts the entire cruise world at your fingertips—from live ship positions to port webcams to your personal cruise logbook.
LIVE SHIP TRACKING
Follow ships from every major cruise line as they sail the seas. See exact positions on the map, current speed, heading, and voyage details. Discover nearby vessels and watch ships arrive and depart from ports around the world.
CRUISE PORTS WORLDWIDE
Explore thousands of cruise ports with detailed information, docked ships, and live webcams. Preview your next destination before you arrive or check conditions at ports across the globe. Save your favorite ports for quick access.
MY CRUISES LOGBOOK
Log your past voyages and plan future adventures. Keep a complete record of your cruise history—ships, dates, destinations, and memories. Add upcoming cruises and watch the countdown to your next departure.
COUNTDOWN WIDGETS
Add beautiful countdown widgets to your home screen. See exactly how many days until your next cruise at a glance. Customize with different styles and watch the excitement build as departure day approaches.
CRUISE PLANNING TOOLS
Stay organized with built-in to-do lists and planning checklists. Create custom lists for packing, shore excursions, or anything you need. Never forget an important task before you set sail.
WEATHER & CONDITIONS
Check real-time weather for any ship at sea, including temperature, wind, and wave height. Perfect for tracking conditions on your upcoming voyage or following friends and family.
MORE FEATURES
• Powerful search to find any cruise ship instantly
• Save favorite ships for quick access
• Dark mode for comfortable nighttime browsing
• Beautiful design crafted for iOS
Whether you're tracking a loved one at sea, planning your next voyage, or simply dreaming of the open ocean, CruiseKick is the ultimate app for cruise enthusiasts.
Download now and start exploring!
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Q: What is the best app to track cruise ships?
A: CruiseKick shows real-time positions for ships from every major cruise line, with live maps, speed, heading, and port arrival details.
Q: How can I find out where a cruise ship is right now?
A: Search for any ship by name in CruiseKick and see its live position on the map, along with current speed and destination.
Q: Is there an app to track my family on a cruise?
A: CruiseKick lets you follow any cruise ship in real-time, so you always know where your loved ones are at sea.
Q: What is the best cruise countdown app?
A: CruiseKick includes home screen countdown widgets, a cruise logbook, and built-in planning checklists to get ready for your voyage.
Q: How do I find what ships are in port today?
A: Browse any cruise port in CruiseKick to see which ships are currently docked, plus live webcams and port details.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
CruiseKick is a subscription app, and a CruiseKick Plus subscription is required to use it. Choose a weekly or yearly auto-renewing plan. Eligible new subscribers start with a 3-day free trial, and the plan's price is charged when the trial ends.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, or when the free trial ends. Your subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula
Privacy Policy: https://velocityraptor.co/app-privacy

bluejetty:00071001:ios.summary:

Join the Marshmallow Heroes - Billy, Willy, and Jackie on their journey to save Lollipop Land from various disas
bluejetty:00071001:ios.description:
Embark on an exciting adventure with Lollipop Sweet Heroes Match3 - the most delectable match-3 game set in a candy wonderland!
Join the Marshmallow Heroes - Billy, Willy, and Jackie on their journey to save Lollipop Land from various disasters threatening its residents. 
If you have a big sweet tooth, you’ll love the classic match-3 gameplay of rainbow mania mixed with candy drops, lollipops, and marshmallows. With thousands of levels and regular updates, this match-3 puzzle game offers unlimited challenge and fun. Sweeten up your crunch time as you match assorted colorful candies through various quests in beautiful, delicious environments like Lollipop Hill & Caramel Swamp. 
Crumble candies, crush lollipops, and have fun with the Marshmallow Heroes! Download Lollipop Sweet Heroes Match3 today and enjoy your match-3 game time!
HOW TO PLAY
• Swap and match 3 or more candies.
• Remove blockers and save the dessert friends in the limited number of moves.
• Collect as many candies as possible by matching to activate Marshmallow Heroes!
• Match to create combinations like Rocket power-ups or Rainbow candies!
• Use powerful boosters like Sugar Bomb and Honey Stick to help with stickier levels.
• Clear levels, earn stars, and get huge rewards!
CANDY COMBINATION TIPS
• Match 4 candies in a square to create a flying rocket!
• Match 5 candies in an L or T shape to get a Bomb power-up!
• Match 5 candies in a line to make a Rainbow candy!
GAME FEATURES
• Over 1000+ exciting levels and frequent updates.
• No time limit so play at your own pace.
• No wifi required. Enjoy online and offline.
• Cotton Candy Tornado: Rescue the baby marshmallows trapped in the Tornado.
• Gingerbread Men: Free Gingerbread Men from the hot oven.
• Hide & Seek: Find the hidden marshmallows stuck under the sugar glass. 
• Ice Cream Flood: Save Lollipop Land from drowning in the flood.
• Pudding Landing: Bring down the Vanilla Pudding to the plate to land perfectly.
NOTES
• Lollipop Sweet Heroes Match3 contains video ads.
• Lollipop Sweet Heroes Match3 is free to play, but you can purchase in-app items like boosters and coins.
• Lollipop Sweet Heroes Match3 can be played on various devices (phones and tablets)
E-MAIL
• contactus@puzzle1studio.com
PRIVACY POLICY
• https://www.puzzle1studio.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00015359:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch into your FAVORITE teacher of Korean.
◆ The most essential words and phrases of the language, each with native speaker audio. 
◆ Master your accent with the Speech Studio. Simply record yourself saying a phrase and then hear your voice next to the teacher’s. You’ll be AMAZED how quickly your foreign accent melts away.
◆ All audio is downloaded to the device and accessible even in airplane mode or without expensive international roaming fees.
◆ Nemo is NOT BUILT AROUND LESSONS at all. It is meant to be picked up and put down throughout the day, whenever you have a few minutes to spare.
◆ Builds a foundation of Korean empowering you to speak CONFIDENTLY in EVERYDAY CONVERSATIONS. 
◆ NO PRIOR KNOWLEDGE of Korean required.
Nemo® is specially DESIGNED to tap the remarkable power of your mobile device, and your brain, to their fullest. 
PERSONALIZED FOR YOU
Nemo is your personal trainer, tracking your PROGRESS across every single word and phrase.
◆ Practice Korean the way you'll use it. Nemo is fully customizable.
◆ Nemo immerses you in the sounds of Korean so you naturally speak with ease.
◆ Dive into WHAT YOU WANT to learn at any time.
◆ You control which words to practice – skip words you don’t want to learn or already know.
◆ Turn on Review Mode to study what you practiced earlier in the day to BOOST your memory retention.
◆ Hear English descriptions of all words, in a flashcard format.
◆ Quiz your mastery of the vocabulary.
◆ Nemo introduces words to you progressively to develop familiarity and reviews them at the right moment so they enter your LONG TERM MEMORY.
TARGET THE MOST COMMON WORDS
Maximize your time investment by targeting the most basic and high frequency words of the language.
Upgrade to the complete version to:
◆ Get off the beaten path or find comfort with DIRECTIONS, TRAVEL and HOTEL phrases.
◆ Decode menus with the most common FOOD words.
◆ Shop and find bargains like an insider with must-know SHOPPING phrases.
◆ Learn words useful for your time in korea.
◆ Build your proficiency with the most important verbs and SENTENCE BUILDING BLOCKS in Korean.
◆ Spark new friendships with COMPLIMENTS and CONVERSATION STARTERS.
Use your new skills to make friends, impress old friends, bring smiles to children, get out of jams, experience new things, speak confidently, and make your travel and cultural experience more rich and fulfilling.
Download this FREE app now!

bluejetty:00120210:ios.name: Inko › Whiteboard: Draw+Pencil
bluejetty:00120210:ios.summary: Inko is a collaborative whiteboard that lets you draw together using multiple iPad, iPhone or Mac, and even interact on Apple TV. Ideal for team coworkers in a brainstorming session, for a creative classroom project, or for an interactive m
bluejetty:00120210:ios.description:
Inko is a collaborative whiteboard that lets you draw together using multiple iPad, iPhone or Mac, and even interact on Apple TV. Ideal for team coworkers in a brainstorming session, for a creative classroom project, or for an interactive meeting between a graphic designer and their client.
Create a group and just start drawing together! No need for complex network setup, or even any network at all, thanks to nearby connectivity. Be it in a bar, or on the beach. Oh, and your drawing even goes to the big screen too thanks to the free companion app for Apple TV! It instantly connects and interacts with all devices in the room. A great alternative to those bulky & expensive interactive boards. Inko 2 now brings remote collaboration over the Internet(*), Dark Mode support, a Mac app, and much more.
Even though Inko is both simple and intuitive, it's also backed with advanced features like beautiful pixel-free rendering that stays sharp when zooming in. It also offers precise Apple Pencil support for an amazing drawing experience, lag-free and undo-capable real-time interactions, as well as hi-res PDF exports to share with your group when you’re done.
COLLABORATION & CONNECTIVITY
• Highly responsive, "appears-as-it-happens" multi-user drawing with no lag.
• Participants’ labels on drawing trails that show who is currently drawing.
• Nearby collaboration: nomadic connectivity for local devices, even without Wi-Fi access point (peer-to-peer or LAN).
• Remote collaboration: seamless connectivity over the Internet for global reach via invitation link sharing.
• Up to 8 participants for peer-to-peer connectivity or 12 participants for LAN/Internet.
• Group saving for quick setup of future sessions.
• Security & privacy: TLS connection between devices (nearby) and end-to-end encryption with daily data removal on server (remote).
• No account creation.
DRAWING & VISUALIZATION 
• Beautiful pixel-free visualization that stays sharp when zooming, as well as vibrant colors on wide color displays (P3).
• High-performance Metal rendering. 
• Extensive Apple Pencil support (finger action, angle, pressure, high-speed & predictive sampling).
• Pen tool with two sizes & one calligraphic variant.
• Lasso editing: select, move, rescale.
• Ephemeral highlighter to point things out. On Apple TV, it even features innovative motion-driven interaction with the remote, like a laser pointer.
• Single- and multi-user undo/redo & reliable syncing.
OTHER FEATURES
• Optimized for latest iOS: file sharing, Split View Multitasking on iPad, Drag & Drop, Today Widget, Quick Actions, Universal Link, Siri Shortcuts, SF Symbols, Smart Screenshot, Dark Mode…
• Universal app for iPad, iPhone & Mac. Free Apple TV companion app(**).
• Export images, hi-res PDF, or native archive for a productive workflow.
• iCloud sync for personal drawings.
PRICING
Multi-user collaboration requires a subscription. Two plans are proposed that enable all your devices (iPad, iPhone, Mac) and let other users join using just the free app:
• Nearby Plan enables local collaboration over peer-to-peer or LAN.
• Remote Plan enables remote collaboration over the Internet. Also includes all features of Nearby Plan.
Both plans offer a fully functional 7-day free trial. The free app provides full drawing capabilities in single-user mode, lets you access, organize, & export your drawings, and let you try out nearby collaboration for 5-minute time-limited sessions. Volume purchase (VPP) is available for schools & businesses: see Inko (Volume Ed.).
HELP & FEEDBACK
Send your questions/feedback to inko@creaceed.com
(*) requires Remote Plan
(**) only works with local connectivity. With older Apple TV models, you can use AirPlay Mirroring. 
Terms of Use: https://creaceed.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://creaceed.com/privacy

bluejetty:00064171:ios.name: Strobe tachometer (RPM meter)
bluejetty:00064171:ios.summary:
STROBE TACHOMETER
When the flicker frequency of light coincides with the speed of any object, such as a fan, the rotating fan may appear to be stationary. Changing the frequency of the flicker of light may help detect the rotation speed.
Y
bluejetty:00064171:ios.description:
STROBE TACHOMETER
When the flicker frequency of light coincides with the speed of any object, such as a fan, the rotating fan may appear to be stationary. Changing the frequency of the flicker of light may help detect the rotation speed.
You may easily use the flicker frequency control buttons to quickly assign the flicker frequency with an accuracy of 0.0001 Hz (0.01 RPM):
• Up to 1000 Hz (60 000 RPM) for a connected flashlight (see the video on YouTube: https://youtu.be/iq6Xiums05o).
• Up to 100 Hz (6000 RPM) for the iPhone flashlight.
IF THE SPEED IS MORE THAN UPPER LIMIT, YOU MAY STILL DETERMINE THE SPEED BY FIRST MAKING MEASUREMENTS WITH A LOWER FLICKER FREQUENCY AND THEN MAKING A SIMPLE CALCULATION (AS EXPLAINED IN THE APPENDIX).
To change the frequency, you should simply press and hold the button. In the app settings, you can adjust the speed at which the flash rate changes when you press and hold the button. The flicker frequency can be displayed either in Hz or RPM.
The image you see will be sharper in lower external light.
After a long period of usage, in case of overheating, the iPhone flashlight turns off automatically.
LASER TACHOMETER
• Measurement range from 0.3 Hz (18 RPM) to 1000 Hz (60 000 RPM).
• Step 0.01-0.0001 Hz (1-0.01 RPM).
• Update time 1 sec.
• 5 mW laser power required.
MAGNETIC TACHOMETER
This tachometer operates by measuring the magnetic field from a spinning magnet. The magnetic field is measured by the iPhone's magnetometer. The magnetic tachometer is best suited for measuring low rotation speeds (from 6 revolutions per minute). It can also be used for measuring medium rotation speeds (up to 2,700 RPM), but at such speeds there is a risk of spontaneous tearing away of the magnet and strong vibration due to center-of-gravity shift.
• Measurement range from 0.1 Hz (6 RPM) to 45 Hz (2,700 RPM).
• Step 0.2-2 %.
• Update time 2-5 sec.

To change the frequency, you should simply press and hold the button. In the app settings, you can adjust the speed at which the flash rate changes when you press and hold the button. The flicker frequency can be displayed either in Hz or RPM.

The image you see will be sharper in lower external light.

After a long period of usage, in case of overheating, the iPhone flashlight turns off automatically.

LASER TACHOMETER
• Measurement range from 0.3 Hz (18 RPM) to 1000 Hz (60 000 RPM).
• Step 0.01-0.0001 Hz (1-0.01 RPM).
• Update time 1 sec.
• 5 mW laser power required.

MAGNETIC TACHOMETER
This tachometer operates by measuring the magnetic field from a spinning magnet. The magnetic field is measured by the iPhone's magnetometer. The magnetic tachometer is best suited for measuring low rotation speeds (from 6 revolutions per minute). It can also be used for measuring medium rotation speeds (up to 2,700 RPM), but at such speeds there is a risk of spontaneous tearing away of the magnet and strong vibration due to center-of-gravity shift.

• Measurement range from 0.1 Hz (6 RPM) to 45 Hz (2,700 RPM).
• Step 0.2-2 %.
• Update time 2-5 sec.

bluejetty:00146044:ios.description:
myTOMRA makes recycling more fun and convenient than ever before. Collect your recyclables, return them to your nearest recycling point and collect your digital refunds. 
YOUR PERSONAL RECYCLING COMPANION
Scan your unique barcode to identify yourself at the Reverse Vending Machine (RVM), so that the correct deposit can be paid directly into your myTOMRA account. 
DISCOVER YOUR CLOSEST LOCATION
Use the map feature to find your nearest recycling point. Check opening hours, accepted bottle types and payout methods. 
EARN BADGES THROUGH ACHIEVEMENTS
Earn badges and track your progress by completing different challenges. 
GO PAPERLESS WITH YOUR RECYCLING
Transfer your refunds automatically to PayPal or similar digital payout methods*, or convert it into a digital receipt for a truly paperless recycling experience. 
GET FULL CONTROL OF YOUR TRANSACTIONS
Check your recycling history and view the status of all your transactions. 
SKIP THE LINE
The Bag Drop feature* allows you to drop entire bags of containers without having to wait in line at the recycling point. Stick the barcode to the bag, scan it with myTOMRA app and drop the bag at the designated location.

bluejetty:00039715:ios.description:
Estamos em um momento de transformação, nos movendo em direção ao futuro sem deixar a nossa essência. Queremos que você sinta o nosso cuidado e experiência onde estiver. Com isso, apresentamos o nosso novo aplicativo. Agora, você poderá ter acesso aos seus agendamentos de maneira rápida e segura, com a mesma confiança de sempre.
Nele, você contará com as seguintes funcionalidades:
