- Atendimentos particulares: mantenha o seu controle e tenha acesso ao valor total e descritivo de itens gerados na conta.
Informações adicionais:
- Neste primeiro momento, a funcionalidade de agendamento de consultas e exames não está disponível no aplicativo. Para isso, entre em contato com a central de agendamentos do Hcor pelo número (11) 3889-3939.
- O acesso ao aplicativo é feito por meio de dados como CPF, data de nascimento e número de token enviado por e-mail ou SMS cadastrados em sua primeira consulta no Hcor.

Meet historical heroes from d
bluejetty:00028019:ios.description:
Arkan: Dawn of knights offers a unique Match-3 gameplay experience that combines the core features of 4x strategy and Match-3 puzzles in a game where heroes gather to fight evil monsters in legendary battles.
Meet historical heroes from different eras and myths in this new 4x4 battle war game and build the strongest kingdom on the map.
When the evil Void Lord destroyed the key of time, wicked monsters invaded our world to destroy it. However, the power of the key broke all barriers of time and space, sending heroes from other worlds and timelines to our universe! You are the only one who can summon these heroes from the key shards to defend your kingdom and save the world. We depend on you! Assemble teams of powerful champions to battle together to defeat the evil lord.
Medusa, Loki, Hercules, Caesar, Athena, Anubis, King Arthur, Hannibal, Napoleon, Captain Hook, and many other heroes from all legends, myths, and tales are waiting for you! Collect them all, upgrade your heroes, customize their abilities and gear, and choose the combination that suits your playing style to win all battles.
Build alliances with friends and compete to gain powerful rewards. Train and deploy your troops to defend your kingdom from rival lords.
--GAME FEATURES--
※ STRATEGY + MATCH-3 ※
- Solve puzzles to fight monsters and advance the campaign.
- Prepare for legendary battles with cunning strategy and unique tactics.
- Summon the greatest champions of all time and use their abilities in match-3 and 4x march battle mode.
※ A LEGENDARY RPG STORYLINE ※
- Play your favorite character from any tale!
- Customize your heroes’ abilities and equip them with legendary weapons to become invincible.
- Experience a new adventure with your champions to defend the universe against the Void Lord.
※ BUILD YOUR KINGDOM ※
- Construct and upgrade 30+ buildings to make your city undefeatable.
- Recruit legends, train troops, adapt your tactics, gather resources, and research new technologies.
- Defeat powerful monsters and wage war against other players on the vast world map.
※ HISTORICAL HEROES ※
- Recruit real heroes and combine their unique skills to defeat the enemies and defend your kingdom in match-3 battles.
- Assemble your champions and benefit from statistical bonuses to boost your troops in strategic expeditions and fights.
※ JOIN ALLIANCES ※
- Join alliances and participate in events and PvP activities to get rewarded with items and resources.
- Invite and fight side by side with your friends to create and strengthen your alliance.
Do you need help?
Feel free to contact us via in-game Customer Service or email us at:
arkan@babilgames.com
Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
https://babilgames.com/privacy-page

bluejetty:00167816:ios.description:
Kuli Kuli is the context-aware voice, text, and camera translator built for real-world travel. Have natural, two-way conversations, enter text, or use your camera to understand menus, signs, products, receipts, handwritten notes, cultural sites, and more.
Go beyond a literal translation. Kuli Kuli adds useful context—dish references, potential allergens, product ingredients, usage details, and cultural explanations—so you can decide what to say, order, buy, or explore.
KEY FEATURES
• Two-Way Voice Conversations — Speak naturally and keep conversations moving when ordering food, shopping, asking for directions, or connecting with locals.
• Text Translation — Enter text for a quick translation whenever you need to understand something or find the right words to reply.
• Context-Aware Camera Translation — Take a photo or choose one from your library to translate printed or handwritten text and get useful context for what you’re seeing.
• Food & Menus — Understand unfamiliar dishes and daily specials, view helpful dish references, and identify potential allergens and ingredients before ordering.
• Shopping & Everyday Essentials — Decode skincare and beauty labels, snacks, pharmacy labels, tickets, receipts, and more.
• Culture & Discovery — Uncover the meaning behind omikuji fortune slips, artwork, landmarks, and local curiosities—not just the words.
Kuli Kuli supports 120+ languages. Feature availability varies by language.
From restaurants and markets to pharmacies and souvenir shops, Kuli Kuli helps you spend less time decoding and more time exploring.

bluejetty:00184532:ios.name: Dojo: Dining Experiences
bluejetty:00184532:ios.summary: At Dojo, we work with our partner restaurants to bring you great dining experiences, when you want them. Grab an instant table to eat now, jump in the virtual queue and have a drink while we queue for you, or immerse yourself and book a pla
bluejetty:00184532:ios.description:
At Dojo, we work with our partner restaurants to bring you great dining experiences, when you want them. Grab an instant table to eat now, jump in the virtual queue and have a drink while we queue for you, or immerse yourself and book a place for that special occasion. Restaurants trust Dojo to facilitate amazing experiences. We drop more great places daily, so you're sure to find something you love.
Features
- Grab last-minute tables instantly
- Queue virtually from up to 5km away
- Book ahead and plan special occasions
Feeling hungry now?
You'll see the places nearby when you launch the app, and booking an available table is a couple of taps away. Restaurants offer last-minute tables, even at peak times. We've optimised the app to show you real-time availability, so grab your slot before somebody else does. Head over to the restaurant, who'll be expecting you, then take a seat and have a great time!
Don't feel like queuing around the corner?
For those extra-special, super-popular places, we offer virtual queuing. Join the queue and we'll send you real-time updates on your position and how long the wait is going to be. Then, you're free to find something better to do with your time. You can message the restaurant while you wait, and they'll notify you when your table is nearly ready. When you join Dojo, you'll be able to join the queue from 2km away. The more you show-up you'll unlock a greater range - up to 5km!
Planning something special, or just like to be organised?
Through Dojo, you can book up to a year in advance(1). This is great for those who like to plan ahead, and key to securing the perfect spot for a grand occasion. You can make a booking at restaurants for larger party sizes, with the entire experience handled directly in the app, including booking deposits, all powered by Dojo. Of course, you can amend or cancel your booking at any time, all through the app.
Got a question or need some support?
At Dojo we provide the very best in customer care. Chat with us directly in the app, drop us an email at [support@dojo.app](mailto:support@dojo.app), or find us on Twitter and Instagram. Our customer support team is available {8am until 8pm every day} to help you with anything from minor questions to event planning emergencies. You're in good hands.
Want to keep your personal data safe?
We've made data security our highest concern, and it's your right to have your data protected and accessible. Find all the details in our Privacy Policy; https://dojo.app/legal/privacy/, or contact our customer support team if you have any doubts or questions.
(1) Each of our partner restaurants decides how long in advance they'd like to take bookings - some have no limit, others like to keep it spontaneous and fresh.

bluejetty:00071015:ios.description:

Key Features:
● Immersive Fantasy World: Explore a richly detailed fantasy setting filled with kings, knights, bandits, and mythical creatures like giants, zombies, and skeletons.
● Roguelike Adventure: Engage in challenging battles against a variety of enemies. Each run is unique, ensuring a fresh and exhilarating experience every time you play.
● Dynamic Combat System: Combine skills strategically to create powerful synergies. Experiment with different skill combinations to develop near-invincible builds.
● Rich Item System: Discover and collect a vast array of items to enhance your character's abilities and strength. The extensive item system ensures endless possibilities for customization and growth.

● Intriguing Quests: Unravel the mysteries of the land. Who are The Seven? Where is the king? Dive into captivating quests that drive the storyline forward and keep you engaged.
● Exclusive Rewards: Earn unique set items, achievements, and special capes reserved for the most veteran players. Show off your accomplishments and stand out in the realm.
Join the Adventure

Prepare to embark on an epic journey, uncover the secrets of the disappeared king, and become the most powerful knight in the land.
Download "Obsidian Knight" now and start your adventure today!

Buddies is a social game designed to bring friends, families, and groups together through fun questions, creative activities, and shared experiences. Create a game room, invite other players, and enjoy entertaining multiplayer rounds that encourage conversation, laughter, and friendly competition.
Whether you’re spending time with family, meeting new classmates, hosting a game night, or connecting with friends remotely, Buddies provides a simple and engaging way to interact together.
Getting started is easy. Each participant downloads the app, one player creates a room, and others join using a game PIN. Once everyone is connected, the game presents a variety of questions and activities designed to spark discussion, encourage teamwork, and create memorable moments.
Explore a wide range of categories suitable for different groups and occasions, including Family, Friends, Colleagues, Travel, Food, Entertainment, Hobbies, and more. Every session offers new content, helping keep gameplay fresh and enjoyable.
Buddies includes thousands of questions and activities that promote communication, learning more about one another, and having fun together. Players can customize their experience with different game settings and modes to match their group’s preferences.
Features:
• Multiplayer gameplay for friends, families, and groups
• Thousands of questions and activities across multiple categories
• Customizable game settings and game modes
• Suitable for in-person and remote play
• Simple room-based multiplayer system
• Regularly updated content
• Designed for a wide variety of social occasions
In the free version, players have access to the Starter Pack with a limited selection of content. A subscription unlocks additional categories, content packs, and advanced game settings.

listings.name: Buddies: Group Games & Quiz
listings.description:
Buddies is the party game that gets everyone talking, whether you've been friends for years or just met. Answer funny questions, vote on who fits best, draw, guess and laugh together. Everyone plays on their own phone: one person creates a room, the others join with a PIN, and the first round starts in seconds.

Made for you and your friends: house parties, birthdays, school trips or just hanging out.

GAME MODES
• Most Likely To: read the question, pick the person who fits it best, then see how everyone voted.
• Would You Rather: everyone answers YES or NO, all choices are revealed and the majority scores the point.
• Creative Answers: the fan favorite. Come up with the funniest answer, like what your friend will be famous for one day.
• Drawing: sketch what the prompt asks for or draw a friend from their selfie.
• Photo Challenges: make the face that fits the situation or copy the pose in the picture.
• Picture Associations: what comes to mind when you see the image? Find out who thinks like you.
• Quiz: funny questions for when you want to switch things up.
• … and more modes to discover.

FEATURES
• Thousands of questions in packs like Icebreaker (for when you're playing with someone new), Sport, Dramas & Comedies, Swag & Stacks, Buddies Forever and Best of the Best.
• Categories like Friends, Travel, Food, Entertainment and Hobbies.
• Seasonal packs, like Halloween, and fresh questions every week.
• Play together in the same room or remotely, each on your own phone.
• Up to 12 players in one game, and it works with just two.
• Vote, see the results and find out how well you really know each other.
• Game settings and modes you can adjust to your group.

HOW TO PLAY
1. Create a room and choose a mode.
2. Invite your friends to join with the game PIN.
3. Pick a category.
4. Answer and vote.
5. Check the results and explain your choices.

PERFECT FOR
• House parties and hanging out with friends
• Birthdays, camps and school trips
• Breaking the ice in a new class, team or group
• Weekends away and road trips with friends
• Video calls with friends who live far away
• Finding out who knows you best

Big fan of Would You Rather and Most Likely To? Buddies is your game. Looking for bolder questions? Check out Buddies Extreme.

SUBSCRIPTION
The free version includes the Starter Pack with a selection of content. A subscription unlocks all categories, content packs and advanced game settings.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account at purchase confirmation.
• The subscription renews automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• You can manage or cancel it anytime in your Apple Account settings.

bluejetty:00042103:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00042103:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone into a walkie talkie in seconds. Pick a channel, hold the button and talk. Everyone on the same channel hears you live. No sign-up, no phone numbers, no contacts needed.
Walkie Talkie Pro is a push to talk (PTT) app for group voice chat over Wi-Fi or mobile data. There's no distance limit: talk across the campsite, the ski slope or the whole country.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick a channel from 1 to 9999
2. Tap Connect
3. Hold the big button to talk, release to listen
Send your channel link and friends join with one tap.
FEATURES
• Real push to talk: hold to talk, release to listen, with a haptic click just like a two-way radio
• Group talk: everyone on the channel hears you at the same time
• Private channels: lock any channel with a 4-digit PIN so only your group can join
• One-tap invite links: friends land straight on your channel, even a private one (the PIN is in the link)
• See who's talking: the radio lights up when someone is on air, with a live participant count and signal bars
• Favourite and recent channels: get back to your group's channel in one tap
• Notifications when someone joins or talks on your channel
• Looks and feels like a real radio: LCD channel display, speaker grille and 4 skins (Classic, Military, Neon, Kids)
• 9 languages: English, Deutsch, Español, Français, Português, Русский, Türkçe, 中文, Azərbaycan dili
PERFECT FOR
• Family: keep in touch with kids at the park, in the mall or on a road trip convoy
• Outdoors: hiking, camping, skiing, hunting, fishing, cycling
• Events and travel: festivals, concerts, theme parks, tour groups
• Work and teams: warehouses, shops, restaurants, construction sites, event staff, security
• Gaming: fast voice chat with your squad
• Home: a simple intercom between rooms
PRO UPGRADE (OPTIONAL)
• No ads
• Private channels stay private much longer
• Unlock the Military, Neon and Kids skins
Walkie Talkie Pro is free to download and use. PRO is an auto-renewing monthly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.
GOOD TO KNOW
• Needs an internet connection (Wi-Fi, 4G or 5G). It does not work offline or over Bluetooth.
• Public channels are open: anyone tuned to the same number can hear you. Set a PIN for private talks.
• The microphone is only used while you hold the talk button.
 Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
 Privacy Policy: https://my-mobile-apps-links.github.io/privacy-policies/walkie-talkie-pro/

bluejetty:00088347:ios.description:
HaxWallet is a crypto wallet app that lets you store any cryptocurrency, including BTC, ETH, and other coin offerings. 
Whether you're new to the concept of blockchain and DeFi or a seasoned pro, this Bitcoin wallet app gives you a user-friendly way to store, send, receive popular cryptocurrencies like BTC, ETH, and XRP, as well as some lesser known token offerings like Bidz coin, Kucoin, and Tron. Effectively, it serves as an Ethereum wallet that supports multiple blockchains.
• Interact with dApps
A USDT wallet that lets you interact with global dApps, so it functions as your DeFi wallet base from where you can access blockchain networks.
• Trust and security by design
A safe Bitcoin wallet app built with trust and security in mind. Protect your digital assets by setting a PIN code or biometric authentication.
• A crypto wallet that emphasizes user-friendliness
With cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin, Tether, and Dogecoin becoming mainstream, you need a mobile digital wallet that won't give you any hassle. The Bitcoin wallet app puts emphasis on a stellar user experience and intuitive design.
• Multi-currency support
A HaxWallet support 2.5M+ cryptocurrency. 
• Customization options for your BTC wallet
Tweak the Bitcoin cash wallet to suit your preferences with several customization options and settings.
• 65 blockchain networks supported
With our user-friendly interface, you can seamlessly access your preferred blockchain network in just two clicks.
• Built-in crypto scam detector
This Bitcoin wallet app helps you mitigate risk by raising a yellow card and flag potentially risky and fraudulent crypto offerings. Manually checking the coin market is very time-consuming, and hardly any other Bitcoin cash wallet displays scam warnings inside its interface.
• Quickly and easily switch between different blockchains
Save time with a Bitcoin wallet app that lets you hop to a different blockchain at the tap of a screen. An Ethereum wallet that lets you focus on your investments.
• Suitable for beginners and pros alike
You shouldn't have to have a PHD to use a USDT wallet, so you'll be getting a powerful backend that is as user-friendly as they make them.

bluejetty:00082748:ios.description:
xDelete will enable you to switch between AWD, AWD Sport and RWD in your xDrive equipped car! Or go custom and change the power distribution with an easy slider!
With xDelete Live, you can now switch your xDrive mode instantly while driving! Flash once and then switch between 4WD, 2WD and 4WD Sport on the fly — directly from your smartphone or with a simple in-car gesture. You can even choose individual presets for every DSC mode (ON, OFF and Traction) and view real-time data and your current AWD mode directly in xDelete.
xDelete Live is currently available for BMW E and F-Series, with support for G-Series in development.
xDelete supports most BMW from MY 2004 up to MY 2021! (E, F and G-Series BMW)
Please go to https://www.xautomotive.com/pages/supported-cars for details!
Facts:
* Smartphone/Tablet App to configure your xDrive-System
* Switch between 4WD, 2WD and 4WD Sport
* xDelete Live: Switch modes instantly while driving
* Individual xDrive presets for every DSC mode
* 100% safe for your car
* Not detectable by the dealer
* No additional hardware to install
* No fault codes triggered
* Steering Assist, ABS & DSC stay fully functional
* You can leave your car in RWD mode forever, or change between AWD and RWD whenever you like
* You can manage unlimited vehicles on one device (Licenses are per vehicle)
More Information on our website: 
https://www.xautomotive.com/products/xdelete

bluejetty:00147453:ios.description:
This app is currently available to Cigna® patients only. 
The Cigna Healthy Pregnancy® app offers you an easy way to track and learn about your pregnancy. It also provides support for baby’s first 2 years! 
There's a lot to keep track of when you're pregnant. The Cigna Healthy Pregnancy® app can help make it simple. Use it to track important dates, learn about your baby’s development and stay on top of your health during every stage of your pregnancy.
Use this app to: 
• Look up and learn about health symptoms and issues during pregnancy with smart search in the Learn Library. 
• Track your weight gain. 
• Keep count of your baby's kicks. 
• Create a list of things to talk about with your doctor, and set reminders.
• Watch videos about your baby’s weekly development.
• Feel connected to your baby with the Baby Boost relaxation tool.
• Get updates with important to dos to stay positive and motivated.
This app is designed to give you the support you need to actively manage your pregnancy and help keep you and your baby as healthy as possible. You also can use it to find local resources and learn about Cigna programs you may be eligible for, such as the Cigna Healthy Pregnancies, Healthy Babies® program.
Just enter your due date and myCigna® user ID and password to get started.
Key Pregnancy Features: 
• Week-by-week updates 
• Due Date Calculator 
• Weight Gain Calculator 
• Pregnancy and postpartum to dos 
• Calendar to track medical appointments 
Key Baby Features:
• Diaper, feeding, and growth trackers for your baby after they’re born
• Developmental milestones and to dos for baby’s first 2 years
• Vaccination tracker and question list for baby’s check ups
The Cigna Healthy Pregnancy® app provides information and tools to help you have a healthier pregnancy and baby. To make the app available to you and other customers, Cigna entered into a service agreement with the developer, Wildflower Health.
The content for the Cigna Healthy Pregnancy® app was developed in conjunction with a board-certified OB-GYN, nurse midwives and other medical experts. Please send your comments and suggestions to: feedback@wildflowerhealth.com.
The Cigna Healthy Pregnancy® app is for educational purposes only. Medical advice is not provided. Do not rely on information in this app as a tool for self-diagnosis. Always consult your doctor for appropriate examinations, treatment, testing, and care recommendations. In an emergency, dial 911 or visit the nearest hospital.

bluejetty:00086817:ios.description:
RacketPal is the #1 app for racket sport fans who want to meet local players and spend more time on the court. Whether you’re playing tennis, badminton, squash, table tennis or padel, there are thousands of players waiting for you to meet and play against.
Finding sport partners in your area is quick and easy. Search players, start a chat and organise a match in a matter of minutes. You can also use the app to find local courts and clubs to book, and off you go. A local tennis partner is there for you a few clicks away. 
Want to up your game? Use RacketPal to find experienced coaches and sparring partners who can take you to the next level.
And, most importantly, have fun!
 - Reasons to love RacketPal
 - Find new racket sports players in your area
 - Set up or join matches with fellow players
 - Play with opponents with the same skill level
 - Join local leagues for competitive fun on the court
 - Spend more time playing the sports you love
 - Our coaches and sparring patterns help improve your game
 - Organise a public game for anyone to join
More features coming soon.

With its user-friendly interface and accurate responses, this app is the perfect alternative to traditional virtual assistants and the perfect tool for anyone looking to improve their communication skills. Whether you're a student, a business person, or simply someone who enjoys engaging conversations, Cleverr ChatGPT AI Assistant is the perfect app for you!

bluejetty:00158215:ios.summary:
“The simplest yet most comprehensive diabetes tool you may ever need.” 
- DiabetesMine
“The best app out there... I've had diabetes for 26 years and tried a lot of apps and I've never seen one done as good as Gluroo.”
- Ashley M., April 20
bluejetty:00158215:ios.description:
“The simplest yet most comprehensive diabetes tool you may ever need.” 
- DiabetesMine
“The best app out there... I've had diabetes for 26 years and tried a lot of apps and I've never seen one done as good as Gluroo.”
- Ashley M., April 2025
Integrates with Dexcom and Libre CGMs, Omnipod 5 and other pumps. Imports your exercise data from Apple Health Kit. Amazing meal nutrition information from a photo -- you have to try it to believe it!
STREAMLINED WORKFLOW FOR DIABETES MANAGEMENT
Manage your diabetes–or help a loved one–with Gluroo, the leading health logging solution used by over 120,000 people worldwide!
LOGGING: COMPREHENSIVE AND EASY!
Gluroo gives you a fast way to log and track everything related to diabetes:
* Food - a quick photo estimates carbs, calories, sugar, and more
* CGM readings and manual finger pricks - just connect your Dexcom (G7, G6, G5) or Freestyle Libre sensor
* Insulin doses - entered manually for MDI, imported from a smart pen, or automatically from DIY Loop, iAPS, or other supported systems
* Exercise - including auto-imports from Apple Health Kit
* Adding a new pump site, CGM sensor, or transmitter - just scan the QR code on the packaging to track their expiration dates and get reminders when you need to change them
SHARE WITH YOUR CARE TEAMS
Gluroo makes it easy to share with your clinic, endocrinologist, dietitian, school nurse, or any health care provider so that they see all the relevant health information you're logging. They can join your GluCrew or securely access the data you share from the convenience of a companion web application at https://app.gluroo.com. You're in control!
NOTIFICATIONS: SMARTER, FEWER
Alerts and notifications invade our lives and can be distracting and overwhelming.
Gluroo uses a new method of coordinated smart notifications which makes sure the right set of people get alerted at the right times. Every alert is actionable. For example, if the person with diabetes (PWD) has low blood sugar, Gluroo will alert them first and give them a chance to address the low.
If they don’t address it within a few minutes, the alert will roll over to the rest of the GluCrew. This lets the PWD develop responsibility and confidence while always having someone else ready to back them up - and reducing alarm fatigue in the process!
SEARCH AND INSIGHTS
As you log meals, doses, exercise and more, you build up a valuable data source. Look back at how you handled a tricky sushi lunch or your favorite pizza joint in the past, expand an inline chart of your blood glucose readings during that period, and use that information to help you handle it better in the future.
INTEGRATIONS:
Gluroo integrates with CGM and Insulin Pumps so that you have everything you need in one place - the only app you'll ever need to manage type 1 diabetes.
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGM) - Dexcom (G7, G6, G5), Freestyle Libre, blood glucose meters, and more planned!
Insulin Delivery Types - Gluroo supports pumps like Omnipod DASH, Omnipod OP5, DIY Loop, and Nightscout instances with more planned!
You can also easily log your daily injections with SmartPens, pens, vials, syringes, and more.
— More Information —
Caution: Dosing decisions should not be made based on this device. The user should follow instructions on the continuous glucose monitoring system. This device is not
intended to replace self-monitoring practices as advised by a physician. Not available for patient use.
Gluroo is neither reviewed by nor approved by the FDA and is free to use.
For more about Gluroo, see also: https://www.gluroo.com
Privacy policy: https://www.gluroo.com/privacy.html
EULA: https://www.gluroo.com/eula.html
Dexcom, Freestyle Libre, Omnipod, DIY Loop, and Nightscout are trademarks of their respective owners. Gluroo is not affiliated with Dexcom, Abbott, Insulet, DIY Loop, nor Nightscout.

bluejetty:00082557:android.description:
Soar through a world suspended high among the clouds as a skilled pilot, commanding your aircraft through mystical islands and engaging in thrilling aerial combat.
Wind up! Time to fix the world!
Game Features:
[Diverse Random Skills – Master the Shoot'em Up Experience]
Choose from a wide variety of roguelike skills that provide powerful combat bonuses! Mix and match them to create spectacular bullet combinations and take on the Nightmare Legion! Every challenge offers a fresh new experience with endless combinations to discover!
[Absorb Pink Projectiles – Become the Sky Ace]
As a skilled pilot, you'll not only dodge countless enemy projectiles but also absorb pink projectiles from dense bullet storms, transforming them into your own combat arsenal. Use your enemies' attacks to enhance your weapons, craft your signature bullet storm, and become the unbeatable sky ace!
[Retro Cartoon Art Style – Return to Innocent Childhood]
Board the time train and journey back to an era of nostalgia and pure wonder as you explore the vast realm of Cloudia! Engage in intense battles with bosses of all shapes and personalities, discover their weaknesses, defeat them one by one, and claim victory with your own hands!
[Diverse Stage Styles – Soar Through Adventure Worlds]
Unknown adventures await your exploration! Challenge over 100 different stages, each with unique terrain and stationed enemies. Adapt your combat strategies to each stage's characteristics as you unveil the mysteries of Cloudia through your adventures!
[Classic Co-op Mode – Let's Fly Together]
Team up with friends for exhilarating co-op battles! Pilot your exclusive aircraft and embark on a wondrous journey together, discovering amazing treasure chests along your combat adventure. Support each other with quick in-game communication and take down bosses with ease!

bluejetty:00018568:ios.name: Bhojdeals (Now Bhoj)
bluejetty:00018568:ios.summary: BHOJ (Previously Bhojdeals) is a One stop mobile app for all the foodies in Nepal, where they can search for their favourite restaurants, get food delivered to their home or office, get awesome deals when they dine-in at the restaurants, re
bluejetty:00018568:ios.description:
BHOJ (Previously Bhojdeals) is a One stop mobile app for all the foodies in Nepal, where they can search for their favourite restaurants, get food delivered to their home or office, get awesome deals when they dine-in at the restaurants, read and post restaurant reviews, explore restaurant menu, earn credits to their BhojWallet and much more. You name it!
BHOJ is also a strong platform for restaurants in Nepal who want to reach out to hungry foodies. Listing on Bhoj App is a very simple process and doesnt take more than a few minutes. If you are a restaurant, feel free to log on to our website (www.bhojdeals.com) and register yourself.
Key Mobile App features include:

bluejetty:00146432:ios.description:
Jornal A Tribuna. O maior e melhor jornal do Espírito Santo.
Com o aplicativo de A Tribuna você irá acessar todo o conteúdo do jornal impresso, de onde você estiver. São mais de 40 conceituados e respeitados colunistas, além das principais notícias do Espírito Santo, do Brasil e do mundo sobre Economia, Política, Polícia, Cultura, Cotidiano, entretenimento e Esportes. 
Com mais de 80 anos de atuação, A Tribuna é o único jornal de grande circulação no Espírito Santo e está presente em todo o Estado no formato físico, e em qualquer lugar no formato digital, se consolidando como a vitrine mais qualificada para a exposição de valor e a efetiva realização dos mais variados negócios.
No aplicativo, você também poderá acessar as últimas notícias do Tribuna Online, o maior portal de notícias do Espírito Santo, com informações sempre atualizadas sobre os mais variados assuntos, com a qualidade e credibilidade do jornalismo da Rede Tribuna.

bluejetty:00119172:ios.description:
Local work. Your terms. Money in your pocket.
Keep 100% of what you earn. Pay zero worker platform fees. Get paid instantly.
Gopher GO connects you with nearby people who need things done—and are ready to pay. Deliveries, errands, rides, moving help, lawn care, junk removal, minor repairs, and more. See the pay up front, choose the jobs you want, and make your next free hour count.
Free to sign up. Free to browse. Free to accept jobs.
HOW IT WORKS
• Find nearby requests with the total pay front and center
• Like the offer? Accept it. Have a different price in mind? Counter it.
• Know what you’ll earn before you go—every dollar, itemized
• Finish the job, add completion photos, and get paid instantly
• Become someone’s favorite: requesters can save you to MY Gophers, giving you first shot at their next job
WHY GOPHER GO
• Keep 100% of your earnings—zero worker platform fees
• Choose your jobs, your price, and how far you’ll travel
• If the job grows, adjust the cost before closing it out
• Get paid instantly, straight to your bank
• Work when you want. Come and go without penalty.
• Build local connections that can turn a job well done into your next opportunity
Someone nearby needs a hand. Your next payday could start with helping them out.
Download Gopher GO and see what’s waiting around the corner.
Your work. Your price. Your call. Let’s GO.
Age-restricted deliveries require valid ID and compliance with all applicable laws.

bluejetty:00091714:ios.description:
Play FREE with ads or unlock more in the gamehouse+ app! Get GH+ Free to access 100+ games with ads, or go GH+ VIP for ad-free play, offline access, in-game perks & more!
When the past meets the present, it's up to three intrepid young archaeologists to unearth the truth!
Unsung Heroes is a brand new time management game from GameHouse. It follows the path of three passionate archaeologists, determined to uncover history! 
In Unsung Heroes - The Golden Mask, the three girls are excavating in China. They stumble upon the story of Xi Niu, a Chinese girl who lived over a thousand years ago. You will switch back and forth between modern day and ancient China as you restore artifacts and slowly start to fill in the story behind them.
Play first as adventurous Ivy, brainy Stephanie and powerhouse Diana as they search for lost treasure. Then go into the past and play as brave Xi Niu, a girl determined to find justice for her family!
As a young girl, Xi Niu watched as her parents were brutally murdered by a man wearing a golden mask. She vows revenge, somehow, some way... 10 years later, she is unexpectedly offered a position as a courtesan in the palace. She seizes the opportunity, as it offers a way to locate the man in the golden mask.
But life is not simple in the palace. It is a snake pit of intrigue and politics and one misstep can mean death. Xi Niu will need to learn how to play the game to survive. Can this girl from the country navigate the dangerous waters of the palace to exact her revenge?
Help the three girl s find the pieces of this puzzle and piece together the story of the brave Xi Niu!
- Play in both the present and the past!
- Find fragments of long-lost artifacts
- Unlock the story as you complete each artifact with a special mini game
- Unearth an ancient culture
- Learn about artifacts based on real findings!
- Master 14 exciting mini games - 7 in the present and 7 in the past
- Explore 4 different dig sites, each with 4 unique artifacts to uncover!
- Discover 6 exotic locations in the past and help Xi Niu find her way
- Find and restore 16 main artifacts and an additional 40 optional artifacts
- Enjoy a delightful new time management story game by GameHouse!

bluejetty:00179859:ios.description:
Sober: Your Path to Freedom and Self-Discovery.
Sober helps you quit or reduce harmful habits — from alcohol and smoking to drugs, junk food and beyond. It’s more than a tracker — it’s a daily source of motivation, reflection, and community support. Wherever you are in your journey, Sober helps you take the next step with confidence and compassion.
Free Features
• Customizable Counter: Track your progress your way — by days, milestones, or moments that matter.
• Custom Wallpapers: Personalize your recovery space to stay inspired every time you open the app.
• Year Overview: See how far you’ve come and celebrate every small victory.
• Motivational Quotes: Daily words of encouragement to keep your spirit strong.
• History of Records: Reflect on your growth and patterns over time.
• Hangover Advice: Practical tips for healthier days and smarter choices.
• Recovery Timeline: Visualize your healing journey from day one to long-term success.
• Anonymous Community Journal: Share your thoughts, victories, and struggles — connect with people who truly understand.
• Social Sharing: Celebrate milestones with beautifully designed posts you can customize and share.
Premium Features
Unlock even more ways to stay motivated and mindful:
• Home Widgets: Keep your counter and quotes visible for constant encouragement.
• Multiple Counters: Track progress for different habits simultaneously.
• Achievements: Earn rewards for milestones that remind you how far you’ve come.
• Savings Tracker: See how much you’ve gained by letting go of what held you back.
You’re Not Alone
Recovery isn’t just about quitting — it’s about rediscovering who you are and creating a life that feels right. Join the Sober community today and take the first step toward a brighter, stronger, more peaceful you.
Download Sober now — your journey starts today.
Terms and conditions:
https://sober.day/terms.html
Privacy policy:
https://sober.day/privacy.html

bluejetty:00065656:ios.description:
Oregano Pizzeria ® has upgraded its mobile ordering application by applying the latest technology to add great features considering customer needs & convenience, it’s very user-friendly, responsive, easy to navigate, and links to Oregano Pizzeria online store in order for you to Pick up your order or get it home and enjoy the ultimate Food & Beverages experience. Oregano Pizzeria has made online pizza ordering now more exciting & convenient. Oregano Pizzeria delivery app enables you to explore the Oregano Pizzeria menu, order pizza online, and get it delivered to your doorstep.
What's new to the Oregano App ® Mobile App?
Discover- Discover Upcoming products and Special offers of Oregano Pizzeria®
Exciting offers- Exclusive Oregano Pizzeria offers & deals customized only for you.
Track your orders Notified and Track the Progress of your order live.
Reward program- Earn points and redeem them for great rewards, enjoy exclusive benefits by collecting points through daily purchasing, and redeeming them to explore a variety of food & beverages in a unique experience.
New Launch / Top selling- Displays Top selling products of Products.
Catering- Oregano Pizzeria® brings catering to their customer to provide the best quality services and memorable experiences. With the new Catering Feature, you can easily Book Our Mesmerised Food truck for Events and enjoy live cooking at anywhere you like.
Oregano pizzeria Ordering app is the fastest way to order your favourite pizza online. Ordering food online within a few clicks has never been so easy. Pick up food from the store or get it delivered to your doorstep, we believe in freshly prepared and unrelenting quality control.
This mobile ordering application is designed to bring Oregano Pizzeria menus are closer to your fingertips. So, you can easily order, choose a store, and pick up time in a fast, easy awesome way to reach your favourite store and find your order ready for delivery or pick up or enjoy at the store. This application will provide a wide variety of Oregano Pizzeria ® products and privileges like Oregano Pizzeria® Rewards, referral program, connecting to all social media accounts of Oregano Pizzeria®, Oregano Pizzeria® information, newsroom about Oregano Pizzeria®. With these new updates in the application, locating Oregano Pizzeria® stores will be very easy, with its GPS functionality it will give the exact location of the stores, its operational timing, and the type of store you prefer.
HOW THE OREGANO PIZZERIA MOBILE APP ORDER WORKS?
1. Download Oregano Pizzeria App and Choose your Preferred Language.
2. Click the “Pickup or Dine-In” option on the application’s main screen.
3. Once you click the system will give you the list of the nearest Oregano Pizzeria® store to you. Choose the store.
4. Discover the best-selling or simply select the food items to order: Just like in the store. 
5. After choosing the desired Food Products, click the “Add” button to include it on your list of purchases then click “View Cart”. The application will give you a summary of your order, including the product’s price, you wanted to pick up your order and pay the way you like.
6. Click “Check out”. The system will give a summary of your order like the estimated pick-up or dine-in or delivery date & time, your delivery address, slots, etc., and can be changed before confirming the order.
7. Choose your payment mode & click “Confirm Order”. The system will give the confirmation email for your order.

bluejetty:00077961:ios.description:
Engage in intense warfare like never before in "War Sniper" the ultimate war game. Immerse yourself in the adrenaline-pumping action of a battlefield where snipers, tanks, and drones are your tools of destruction. War Sniper is an exciting and realistic war combat game with a massive campaign mode that can be played offline and a real-time multiplayer PvP combat mode. Are you ready to take the shot and lead your squad to victory?
Key Features:
• Sniper Showdown: Become the deadliest sniper on the battlefield and eliminate enemy targets with precision. Take your shots from hidden vantage points and make each bullet count.
• Tank Warfare: Command powerful tanks and unleash devastation on the battlefield. Roll over enemy lines and dominate the warzone with heavy firepower.
• Powerful Drones: Pilot a variety of deadly drones, each equipped with a unique arsenal of weapons. Upgrade your drones for maximum devastation and precision shooting. Target enemies with pinpoint accuracy as you unleash a hail of bullets and missiles.
• Realistic Campaign Battlefields: Immerse yourself in stunning 3D environments that capture the chaos and intensity of modern warfare. From urban warfare to desert landscapes, each map presents unique challenges.
• Competitive PvP: Climb the ranks and prove your skills in intense PvP battles. Earn rewards and prestige as you become a renowned war hero.
• Rank Up: Climb the ranks and earn rewards as you prove your skills on the battlefield. 
• Stunning Graphics: Experience the chaos of war with stunning visuals, realistic sound effects, and immersive gameplay.
• Prepare for war, commander! The battlefield is calling, and only the best snipers, tank commanders, and drone operators will emerge victorious. Download "War Sniper" and step into the heart of modern warfare today!

bluejetty:00100569:ios.name: Pocket for Seerr
bluejetty:00100569:ios.summary:
Pocket for Seerr is a native iOS companion for your Overseerr / Jellyseerr / Seerr server, built to make media requests fast and effortless from your phone.
IMPORTANT: This app requires a self-hosted Seerr, Overseerr or Jellyseerr backend
bluejetty:00100569:ios.description:
Pocket for Seerr is a native iOS companion for your Overseerr / Jellyseerr / Seerr server, built to make media requests fast and effortless from your phone.
IMPORTANT: This app requires a self-hosted Seerr, Overseerr or Jellyseerr backend server. It does not function as a standalone application.
Connect to your existing Seerr instance and:
• Browse and search your media
Quickly look up movies and TV shows available through your Plex, Jellyfin, or Emby libraries, with the same metadata and posters you see in Seerr on the web.
• Request what you want to watch
Send requests for movies, seasons, or full series in a few taps. See at a glance what’s already available, what’s pending, and what’s been approved or rejected.
• Keep track of request status
View your own request history and status updates in one place so you always know what’s coming to your server next.
• Manage requests on the go (for admins)
If you’re an admin or have request-management permissions in Seerr, you can approve or decline requests directly from Pocket, without opening a browser. Stay on top of your queue from anywhere.
• Built for iOS
Pocket for Seerr is a clean, responsive native app designed to feel at home on iPhone. Fast navigation, familiar patterns, and an experience tuned for quick actions make handling requests painless.
Requirements
Pocket for Seerr is an unofficial client and requires an existing Seerr / Jellyseerr / Overseerr server configured with your media stack (Plex, Jellyfin, or Emby, plus Radarr/Sonarr, etc.).
No third-party accounts, subscriptions, or hosted services are included.

bluejetty:00044559:ios.summary: Take control of your environment and make the invisible, visible! The Alen Air app gives you the power to see, control, and analyze your air quality, all in one place, wherever you are. Have you ever wanted to "know it's working"? Now you c
bluejetty:00044559:ios.description:
Take control of your environment and make the invisible, visible! The Alen Air app gives you the power to see, control, and analyze your air quality, all in one place, wherever you are. Have you ever wanted to "know it's working"? Now you can! 
Wirelessly control your entire environment, connect to multiple Alen purifiers or Alen Air Quality Monitors right from your phone!
Harness the power of Alen's advanced sensor technology, vivid color rings, and proactive notifications. This app update includes features such as:
Easily add your Alen BreatheSmart 25i, 35i, 45i, 75i purifiers, and Alen Air Quality Monitor (AQM) into the Alen Air app via Wi-Fi or Bluetooth.
The new first-time user experience is designed to get customers up and running in minutes, with a guided, low-friction setup that focuses only on what’s essential. Account creation is simple and clearly explained, requiring minimal information and setting expectations upfront about how data is used. Biometric authentication via Face ID or Touch ID, or authentication using your passcode, provides an optional additional layer of security! 
Once signed in, users can quickly connect their purifier, view air quality at a glance, and control core features without digging through settings. Privacy controls are introduced early and transparently, easy choices that put users in control from the start making clean air immediately accessible.
Creating a new location has never been easier. Simply provide your city or zip code and Alen Air automatically selects the closest outdoor air quality monitor to your locality giving you a good idea about outdoor air quality so you can compare it against your indoor air quality. 
Easily pair your Alen purifier or AQM with the new device onboarding process. Your Wi-Fi network can be automatically detected or, for enhanced security, manually enter your Wi-Fi name and password. Pairing happens through a Bluetooth connection for a fast, no hassle experience making it easy to control your Utopiar.
Alen’s filters have a fresh new look: Pure is now Essential, Fresh is now Advanced, and Odor is now Ultimate. It’s the same filtration you know, now with names that make it easier to choose the right filter for your needs.
Set custom schedules that make sense for your personal life or business, on a single or multiple purifiers. Organizations with many purifiers can achieve efficiencies by setting multiple schedules to reduce day-to-day manual operations.
View your indoor and outdoor air quality, both current and historical, with easy-to-read graphs. Download historical data for custom analysis!
Receive Notifications if your Air Quality reaches a level requiring your attention, like prolonged periods of poor air quality.
Keep your purifiers operating at optimum levels by enabling automatic firmware updates and receiving notifications for when your filter is close to needing replacement, as well as ordering the correct filters by leveraging the app's ability to recognize your purifier model.

Tot is an elegant, simple way to collect & edit text across your Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. It’s your tiny text companion!
⁕ Less Is More
Tot’s single window design and simple formatting controls mean no more hunting for that chunk of text. Seven color-coded dots let you organize your notes while keeping them from getting out of hand.
⁕ Dark / Light Mode
Designed to look stunning both day and night, Tot takes full advantage of iOS and macOS themes.
⁕ Small Footprint
Stays out of the way on the desktop with minimal chrome and can even be controlled via the Menu bar. On mobile, each dot is just a swipe away.
⁕ iCloud Sync
Seamlessly syncs your text across iOS and macOS using iCloud so you can capture thoughts wherever you are.
⁕ Markdown Support
Full support for rich or plain text and even automatically translates text to Markdown for handy use on the web. Have an RTF file you need marked up? No problem!
⁕ Killer Keyboard
Tot puts common text operations on the keyboard and keeps track of word and character counts as you type.
Available for iOS, macOS, and watchOS.

bluejetty:00016628:ios.description:
Build card piles from 13 down to 1, with alternating colors. It's like the solitaire game Klondike, but in a circle. You play against 3 robot players, and the first one to empty his hand wins the game!
Seven cards are dealt to each of 4 players. On her turn, a player draws a card from the draw pile, then places alternating red and white cards on the table stacks in order. Corner stacks must count down from 13. Play continues around the table until one player empties her hand.
The deck has high-contrast cards with large numbers for better accessibility. A paid, no-ads version called Kings in the Corners Gold is also available.

bluejetty:00093209:ios.description:
Most people start strong. Habitude makes sure you finish.
Build habits that actually stick — with XP, streaks, challenges, and a Focus Timer that turns your daily routine into the most rewarding experience you'll ever have.
—————————————————
GAMIFY YOUR HABITS
Earn XP every time you complete a habit. Level up your profile, unlock achievements, and compete in streak challenges with friends. Progress doesn't feel like discipline — it feels like winning.
BUILT FOR ADHD MINDS
Overwhelmed by generic to-do apps? Habitude's ADHD-friendly Playbooks give you curated, science-backed routines designed to reduce cognitive load and help you stay consistent — even on hard days.
AUTOMATIC HEALTH SYNC
Habitude reads directly from Apple Health — tracking your steps, water intake, sleep, calories, and workouts automatically. No manual logging, no friction.
CHALLENGES WITH FRIENDS
Start a streak challenge, invite your friends, and compete to see who can stay consistent the longest. Real accountability from the people who know you best.
INSIGHTFUL WEEKLY REPORTS
Understand your patterns with weekly, monthly, and yearly analytics. See which habits are sticking, which are slipping, and where to focus next.
FOCUS TIMER (POMODORO)
Power through deep work with a built-in distraction-free Pomodoro timer. Pair it with a habit and close the loop every session.
MOOD TRACKING
Log your mood daily and discover how your habits affect your mental wellness over time. Small data points, big insights.
FLEXIBLE GOAL TYPES
Track habits the way they make sense — in minutes, pages, glasses of water, or miles. Not every goal fits a simple checkbox.
SMART REMINDERS
Set multiple reminders per habit with custom sounds. Never miss a beat, never break a streak.
HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
Log habits directly from your Lock Screen or Home Screen widget. Zero friction, zero excuses.
CLOUD SYNC
Your data stays with you — securely backed up and synced across all your devices, always.
BEAUTIFUL THEMES
Choose from custom color palettes and a sleek dark mode for a premium experience that feels like yours.
—————————————————
HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick your habits — choose from templates or create your own
2. Set your schedule and reminders — morning, evening, or anytime
3. Log, earn XP, and level up — every check-in builds momentum
—————————————————
Whether you want to build a morning routine, drink more water, read every day, quit a bad habit, or finally manage your ADHD — Habitude adapts to you. Not the other way around.
Download Habitude free today. Your future self starts now.
—————————————————
NOTE: Habitude optionally reads data from Apple Health (steps, energy, walking, running, etc.). No data is ever sent outside your device. Health access is required only for syncing these habits.
EULA: https://habitude.com.br/terms
Privacy Policy: https://habitude.com.br/privacy

NEW: iOS 26+ NATIVE RINGTONE FEATURE
Revolutionary one-ta
bluejetty:00178311:ios.description:
Create custom iPhone ringtones in seconds—no computer needed! The easiest and fastest ringtone maker for iOS. Pick any song or video, trim it, and set it as your ringtone instantly.
NEW: iOS 26+ NATIVE RINGTONE FEATURE
Revolutionary one-tap ringtone setup! iOS 26 and newer users can set ringtones instantly using the native "Use as Ringtone" feature. No GarageBand, no computer—just tap and done!
KEY FEATURES
RINGTONE MAKER
- Create ringtones from iTunes library songs
- Import audio files from Files app or iCloud
- Convert videos to ringtones (extract audio)
- Precise trimming (0.5-30 seconds)
- Visual circular slider for easy editing
- Custom text tones and notification sounds
VIDEO TO AUDIO CONVERTER
- Extract audio from any video file
- Convert MP4, MOV, AVI videos to audio
- Export as MP3 or M4A format
- Perfect for music videos and concerts
PROFESSIONAL AUDIO EFFECTS
- Fade in and fade out effects
- Echo and reverb effects
- Real-time audio preview
- Enhance your ringtones with studio-quality sound
MUSIC EDITOR AND EXPORTER
- Edit and export iTunes music
- Share songs with friends
- Export full songs as MP3 or M4A
- Edit song metadata (title, artist, artwork)
- Add custom album covers
EASY TO USE
- No computer or iTunes sync required
- Simple 3-step process
- Works offline—no internet needed
- Supports all audio formats: MP3, M4A, WAV, AIFF
ACCESSIBILITY
- Full VoiceOver support for blind users
- Accessible controls throughout the app
NO SUBSCRIPTION
- Completely free to use
- Optional one-time purchase to remove ads
- No monthly fees ever
HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick a song from your library or import a file
2. Select your favorite part with the circular slider
3. Add audio effects (optional)
4. Tap Save and choose "Ringtone file"
5. iOS 26+: Tap "Use as Ringtone" and you are done!
 iOS older than 26: Share to GarageBand and export as ringtone
PERFECT FOR
- Custom ringtones and text tones
- Alarm sounds and notification tones
- Music lovers and K-pop fans
- Anyone who wants unique sounds
COMPATIBILITY
- Works with purchased iTunes songs
- Supports synced music files
- DRM-protected Apple Music NOT supported
- All video and audio formats supported
SUPPORT
Need help? We are here for you!
Website: musictoringtoneios.com
Instagram: @music.to.ringtone
Email: musictoringtoneios@gmail.com
Download now and create unlimited custom ringtones for FREE!
iOS 26+: Native ringtone support—no GarageBand needed!
iOS older than 26: Install GarageBand for easy setup

bluejetty:00087297:ios.description:
Learn languages with music you love
Learn Spanish, Portuguese, French, Italian, Korean, German, Russian, Dutch, Swedish, Polish, Turkish, Finnish, Romanian and Ukrainian.
Turn the songs you already play into language lessons, using lyrics from the artists you actually listen to.
You're discovering new music, playing lyric games, and singing along. You're also practicing vocabulary, grammar and sentence patterns, and getting pronunciation practice every time you sing.
That's the whole idea: learn a language during time you were going to spend on music anyway.
Achieve your language-learning goals by listening to music
You already listen to music for hours every day. That same time can move you toward your goals instead.
Find your next favorite artist
Bored with your current playlist? Discover new artists while you learn.
Culture comes with the language
Music carries the culture a language lives in. A song tells a story, and a story is easier to remember than a word list.
Everything you need to follow a song
Tried listening to music in your target language and lost the thread? Every song has full lyrics, translations and explanations, so you can follow along.
Song too fast? Line-by-line mode lets you take it at your own pace.
Tap any word for its translation and hear it spoken. You can also hear the full lyric line read aloud.
Spaced repetition
Save the words you meet and review them later. Our spaced repetition algorithm brings each one back just as you're about to forget it, which is what moves it into long-term memory.
Music is repetitive, and that is the point
If you love a song you play it again and again, and every replay is another pass over the same words. Different lesson types give you more ways to practice them.
Learn with over 49,000 songs across 14 languages
Songs from artists you already follow are probably here. If one is missing, request it and we'll try to add it.
It takes 600 to 2000 hours to learn a language. This is a way to spend some of them on music.

bluejetty:00121171:ios.description:
Weak dinosaurs fall prey to strong dinosaurs.
With the instinct of dinosaurs, attack and hunt without halt!
Find and hunt prey for your survival, and grow faster and more strongly than other dinosaur tribes.
You can protect your tribe from the threat and attacks of other tribes, and enjoy hunting with friends from all over the world. Don’t miss out the opportunity to meet enormous kinds of dinosaurs and living things from the Jurassic period. Oh, you can meet alien beings. 
Features
· When you start the game, you can choose one tribe among Dilophosaurus, Compsognathus, Oviraptor, and Velociraptor.
· You can find an enormous kinds of dinosaurs that lived in the Mesozoic Era such as Velociraptor and T-rex, a carnivorous dinosaurs, as well as Apatosaurus and Triceratops that are herbivorous dinosaurs.
· If you succeed in hunting, other dinosaurs of your tribe around you also receive the experience points.
· You can enjoy hunting in the map that has over 13 various characteristics and geographical features. 
· You can summon the dinosaurs of your tribe through the summoning function. 
· If you die several times in the beginning of the game, you will be transformed into a huge different dinosaur for each tribe.
· Try hunting a gigantic King Kong in the King Kong Field. If you succeed in its hunting, you will receive a Tyrannosaurus pet as a reward.
· You can fight all dinosaurs regardless of tribes only in the Colosseum of map. 
· In the Black Hole region where a meteor has dropped, you can meet huge monsters that have appeared in 4Force Online game.
· In the Sky Land, you will turn into a King Kong if you eat a dead extraterrestrial life.
※ This game has removed violent descriptions and expressions in it to protect children and adolescents, and provides a chatting-off function to prevent inappropriate conversations.
※ You cannot recover the game once it is deleted
Developer’s Message
I apologize for not making Dinos Online at the right time as I promised. In fact, we are a small game development company that has only a few employees and not enough money. That’s why we’re so late. But please keep supporting the games of 1Games from now on!
Please visit our Facebook(www.facebook.com/dinosgame) or Youtube(www.youtube.com/user/hanaGames) page if you want more information.

bluejetty:00173177:ios.description:
Sea Battle is a board game everybody loves since childhood but with new options! Online multiplayer! Fight against the players from all over the world! You have a wide arsenal in your disposal: battleships, destroyers, bombers, mines, anti-aircraft defense, radars and other stuff. Place your ships of different size on the battlefield, launch the aircraft for massive bombshells and try to sink the rival ships.
By combining different positioning of your ships, aircraft, anti-aircraft defense and mines you can develop your own strategy for the game and leave no chances for your opponents!
Sea Battle is a game with elaborate squared notebook graphics and effects, which make the game original and create a special atmosphere!
Game’s special features:
ONLINE FIGHTS:
Fight against opponents from all over the world over the Internet!
PLAY VS AI:
Choose the difficulty level and try to beat AI. Earn points!
PLAY VIA BLUETOOTH:
Arrange battles against your friends and colleagues via Bluetooth. 
PLAY WITH YOUR FRIEND ON ONE DEVICE:
You want to play with your friends on one device? Notaproblemanymore! Placeyourships, aircraft, mines, AAD and radars each in his or her turn and fight!
POINTS FOR VICTORIES:
Earn points by winning and buy aircraft, mines, AAD and radars and other stuff!
CHOOSING AND SETTING GAME MODES:
Choose the classic or advanced game mode. Change your arsenal any way you want.
*****
It’s high time to find out, who is the best at Sea 
Battle!
*****
The game is free and with no in-game purchases required!

bluejetty:00119922:ios.description:
Contents:
• Radio play-like audio walks in museums and parks
• Audio guides in the museums
• Interactive map to discover the cultural city of Weimar
• Theme tours in the city and in parks
• Interactive games and AR applications
• Additional materials such as videos and interviews
• More service information
The free Weimar+ app is your multimedia guide through the cultural city of Weimar. In addition to audio tours and atmospheric audio walks through downtown Weimar and the museums and historical parks of the Klassik Stiftung Weimar, the app offers numerous multimedia information and tours on the topics of Weimar classicism, modernism and historical parks.
You can use an interactive map to explore the language area of the city of Weimar, the Park on the Ilm and the Belvedere Castle Park individually for yourself. With activated GPS, you can display all audio stops in the immediate vicinity and go on a discovery tour using a filterable recommendation system. Are you looking for the nearest WiFi hotspot or museum shop? No problem - in our legend you can display all service information about your visit.
Discover our game with AR functions in the Park on the Ilm and in the Nietzsche Archive. Packed in various small puzzles, the individual locations can be explored from a new perspective. Help us document the changes at selected sites for our future resarch efforts and learn more about these sublime views. In the Herzogin Anna Amalia Bibliothek, an AR application gives you the opportunity to take books off the shelves and take a look at the treasures of the famous library. There is also a 3D application for the Nietzsche Archive, with which Nietzsche's death room can be explored virtually.
The app helps you prepare for and follow up your visit with in-depth information, interviews with our curators, video features of the artists and gardeners, hearing a matter of debates that address the political and cultural present as well as event recommendations.
The featured tours allow you to immerse yourself in our exhibitions and parks and are accompanied by handicap accessible services and programmes for children. The app is designed to regularly update new content so that it can better cater to your needs.

listings.name: Weimar+
listings.description:
Contents:
• Radio play-like audio walks in museums and parks
• Audio guides in the museums
• Interactive map to discover the cultural city of Weimar
• Theme tours in the city and in parks
• Interactive games and AR applications
• Additional materials such as videos and interviews
• More service information

The free Weimar+ app is your multimedia guide through the cultural city of Weimar. In addition to audio tours and atmospheric audio walks through downtown Weimar and the museums and historical parks of the Klassik Stiftung Weimar, the app offers numerous multimedia information and tours on the topics of Weimar classicism, modernism and historical parks.

You can use an interactive map to explore the language area of ​​the city of Weimar, the Park on the Ilm and the Belvedere Castle Park individually for yourself. With activated GPS, you can display all audio stops in the immediate vicinity and go on a discovery tour using a filterable recommendation system. Are you looking for the nearest WiFi hotspot or museum shop? No problem - in our legend you can display all service information about your visit.

Discover our game with AR functions in the Park on the Ilm and in the Nietzsche Archive. Packed in various small puzzles, the individual locations can be explored from a new perspective. Help us document the changes at selected sites for our future resarch efforts and learn more about these sublime views. In the Herzogin Anna Amalia Bibliothek, an AR application gives you the opportunity to take books off the shelves and take a look at the treasures of the famous library. There is also a 3D application for the Nietzsche Archive, with which Nietzsche's death room can be explored virtually.

The app helps you prepare for and follow up your visit with in-depth information, interviews with our curators, video features of the artists and gardeners, hearing a matter of debates that address the political and cultural present as well as event recommendations.

The featured tours allow you to immerse yourself in our exhibitions and parks and are accompanied by handicap accessible services and programmes for children. The app is designed to regularly update new content so that it can better cater to your needs. 

We look forward to your feedback and suggestions!

bluejetty:00185138:ios.description:
"THE MEME APP OF THE CENTURY HAS ARRIVED!!!" MLG Soundboard Ultimate Memes is THE DOPEST meme Soundboard on the App Store, but what makes it worthy of this title? Join us on an epic journey to find out...
Deep within the lands of Kekistan, a legendary meme archive was hidden, waiting to be discovered. The Secret Society, a group of brave dankologists, embarked on a perilous quest to uncover the secrets of Dankstorm. The society came to the entrance of a dark cave. Low rumbling and howls emanated from the deep black void. The squeak of a unicycle broke through the eerie ambiance as a small green tree frog wheeled himself out in front of the visitors. “WADDUP”, he asked. As he stood still at the entrance of the dark cave. A brief moment of quietness elapsed, as the dankologists exchanged some low whispers as they prepared to communicate with the unicycle frog. They began to crank dat, but the frog sat expressionless. He then turned around and wheeled away back into the dark. The dankologists were confused. Did he want a default dance? No. He wheeled out momentarily, grasping the loot box between his tiny hands. A large voice loomed out, the meme overlord army coming to capture the loot box was mobilizing across the arid desert. "DESTROY THE CHILD. CORRUPT THEM ALL." said the Overlord. Meme minions with Mtn Dew cannons came in overwhelming numbers. The green tree frog dropped the loot box and wheeled away. We knew we were outnumbered, but there was hope, for it was a Double XP weekend. A crack rang through the air as the first line crumbled suddenly. Harambe emerged, standing mighty and high. I was awestruck as echoes of children screamed "collateral!” A hail and thicket of hitmarkers followed, leaving the enemy opposition pwned, humiliated as they awaited their killcam.
Before reinforcements could arrive, Harambe galloped towards us and yanked me behind a boulder. “You must get out of here before the enemy AC-130 arrives” Harambe said. Sanic's army was approaching fast. “You must go. Take the loot box with you." Crouching down. Harambe placed a hand onto my shoulder. I glanced at his hairy hand and then widely back at him. "Come with us, Harambe. You are wanted back home”. Harambe firmly nodded. His noble gaze met my stunned eyes. I feared I knew his answer. “I must defend Kekistan.” He downed his can of Dew and turned to face the enemy. I chose not to look back. For if I did, I would've stayed with him.
I heard the sound of a bullet whipping through flesh. Harambe let out a beserk roar, bearing his teeth as he proceeded to dual wield akimbo Interventions. We knew we didn’t have much time. The sand was blowing harder into our ankles as the chopper blades began to spin faster and faster until it was no longer in rhythm with our heartbeats. They sank into our chest as the chopper started lifting from the ground. Weightlessness overcame me as I leaped through the dust clouds to grab the handle of our friendly chopper gunner. The dankologists glanced at me in horror, unable to keep up. I pulled a wombo combo to jump off and ricochet back to the helicopter with the dankologists safely in my grasp. Their expressions were stuck in silent screams, drowned out by the thunder of Harambe’s midnight launch heroics.
Harambe was honored in a ceremony back home, where he was awarded the Meme of Honor. I turned to face his statue. The fierceness of his glorious dab contrasted the calm quiet autumn winds. Nevertheless, he rocked it until the wheels fell off. He dropped it like it was hot. His commitment to memes in life and service earned him his prestige. On the bottom of his statue were three simple words, decorated with engraved leaves.

bluejetty:00185239:ios.summary: If you love solving ingenious puzzles, you need Logic Dots 2! A uniquely fantastic combination of Sudoku and Battleship, it's easy, addictive and logical to play. Place dots on the grid to make shapes and solve each puzzle. This award-winni
bluejetty:00185239:ios.description:
If you love solving ingenious puzzles, you need Logic Dots 2! A uniquely fantastic combination of Sudoku and Battleship, it's easy, addictive and logical to play. Place dots on the grid to make shapes and solve each puzzle. This award-winning puzzle sequel is simple and logical, but increasingly challenging.
Version 2.0 of Logic Dots 2 is here! Incredibly, we have unlocked ALL of Logic Dots 2’s original levels and made all 210 levels FREE for EVERYONE to play! We’ve also added 480 NEW themed levels, redesigned and improved menus and tutorials, and your progress in a puzzle is now auto-saved when you leave mid-game!
- Note: Players who “Unlocked All Packs” in previous versions of Logic Dots 2 will unlock ALL 240 Difficult Pack levels in this new v2.0 update for FREE!
- Note: Players who purchased “Unlimited Hints” in previous versions of Logic Dots 2 will unlock 480 new levels including ALL Difficult Pack levels FREE and ALL Lines & Dots Pack levels FREE in this new v2.0 update!
Each brain-twisting Logic Dots 2 puzzle consists of a blank grid surrounded by numbers. Players need to find hidden dot lines and now shapes on the grid, making sure each row and column contains the indicated number of dots. This massively-anticipated sequel builds upon its acclaimed puzzle-board predecessor, the #1 puzzle-board game on the App Store with almost 1 million players in a week - incredible!
There are no time limits or move limits, and hints are freely given in some puzzles to make them easier on players. Beware though - as the game progresses, deduction challenges become increasingly devilish. Only true ‘Logic Legends’ will make it to the end of Logic Dots 2!
- USE LOGIC TO WIN: Place dots in the grid to create dot lines and shapes to solve each logic puzzle.
- BEAUTIFUL PRESENTATION: Gorgeous, colorful levels are now even more of a treat for your eyes. Logic Dots is color-blind friendly as well!

Nonogram is an addictive brain game that combines logic puzzles with pixel art. Solve picture cross, train your logic.
With simple rules and challenging solution, you can reveal the pixel pictures and finish the picture cross. Nonogram is made for all ages and skill levels, you can travel in different thematic scenes and discover tons of picture cross puzzles! 
This entertaining logic grid puzzle game is also called Picross or Griddlers. It origins from the Japanese crossword game. If you are a fan of logic puzzles, you will feel the challenge and fun. If you are interested in picture cross and pixel art, you will have an immersive experience with endless levels and amazing pixel pictures.
What are you waiting for? Take up the challenge and sharpen your brain now!
Features:
• Free game
• Simple rules: use logic to color the grid blocks, reveal hidden pixel picture..
• Endless logic puzzles, from easy to hard, keep updating. 
• Amazing pixel art: discovering beautiful pixel art illustrations of different themes, including daily objects, plants, characters and cute animals, etc.
• Automatically save game progress, no data loss.
• Different logic puzzle levels, suitable for children and adults.
• Play offline, no need mobile data
• Simple and intimate game design, logic puzzle game can also be beautiful.

bluejetty:00070718:ios.description:
Hey Twitch Streamers!
StreamKit is the easiest way to edit and share your Twitch clips to TikTok and Instagram, and track how you grow your channel!
StreamKit makes it easy to share and edit clips, measure growth, and identify your top fans. Here's how it works:
1) You connect your Twitch account
2) We monitor your channel daily so we can show you your followers and UNFOLLOWERS
3) When you go live we see who is watching your stream so we can tell you who stops by (and who doesn't)
4) After your stream, edit Twitch clips into short videos that you can share on other social media channels right inside the app!
Here's a list of our most popular features:
- Convert clips into shareable videos on your iPhone in seconds
- Daily updates on Viewers, Followers, and UNFOLLOWERS
- Monitor live streams to count how long viewers watch your stream (counts only start after connecting your account to StreamKit)
- Monitor live streams to count how long users YOU FOLLOW watch your stream (count only starts after connecting your account to StreamKit)
StreamKit is 100% FREE while we get ramped up, so sign up now and super charge your channel.
Huge thank you to https://www.twitch.tv/stasonbobo for letting me use his clips on the previews!
PRIVACY POLICY
https://www.getstreamkit.com/privacy
TERMS OF USE
https://www.getstreamkit.com/terms
STREAMKIT IS NOT AFFILIATED WITH TWITCH.

bluejetty:00179264:ios.name: Speak4Me Text to Speech Reader
bluejetty:00179264:ios.summary: Speak4Me is a text to speech app that does two things: it reads aloud anything you want to listen to, and it speaks out loud anything you type. Listen to PDFs, documents, books, web articles and photos of printed pages – or type a message a
bluejetty:00179264:ios.description:
Speak4Me is a text to speech app that does two things: it reads aloud anything you want to listen to, and it speaks out loud anything you type. Listen to PDFs, documents, books, web articles and photos of printed pages – or type a message and let Speak4Me say it for you, in 120+ natural AI voices.
LISTEN: READ ALOUD ANYTHING
• PDF to audio – Import any PDF from Files or iCloud Drive and listen to it like an audiobook. Headers and footers are skipped automatically, so you only hear the content.
• Documents and books – Turn long documents, book chapters, study notes and reports into audio. Follow along with real-time text highlighting.
• Web articles – Listen to articles, blog posts and newsletters instead of reading them on screen.
• Scan and listen – Take a photo of a printed page, a book, a letter or a menu, and Speak4Me reads the text out loud.
• Listen anywhere – Keep listening while you commute, walk, work out or cook. Speed up the voice to get through your reading list faster.
SPEAK: TYPE TO SPEAK
• Type and Speak4Me talks for you – Write what you want to say and it is spoken out loud instantly, in the voice and language you choose.
• A voice when you need one – Made for people who have lost their voice, have a speech disability, are recovering from a stroke, or find it hard to speak in some moments. Use it to talk face to face, at the doctor, in a shop or on the phone.
• Favorite phrases – Save the sentences you use most and play them with one tap.
• AI voice-overs – Use Speak4Me as an AI voice generator and narrator: type a script and export it as an MP3 for videos, TikTok, Reels, podcasts, presentations and customer support.
NATURAL AI VOICES
• 120+ lifelike AI voices, male and female, in 20+ languages and accents.
• Ultra voices: our most human, expressive and fluid voices.
• Adjust voice speed and font size to fit the way you read.
MADE FOR EVERY READER
• Dyslexia-friendly font and text highlighting to make reading easier.
• Helpful for dyslexia, ADHD, low vision, language learners and anyone who prefers listening to reading.
• Save any audio and share it via iMessage, WhatsApp, email and more.
WHO USES SPEAK4ME
Students who listen to their notes and PDFs. Professionals who turn reports and emails into audio. Book lovers who listen to what they read. People who use their phone as a voice to communicate. Creators who need quick voice-overs.
FAQ
• Can Speak4Me read PDFs aloud? Yes. Import any PDF and listen to it like an audiobook, with headers and footers skipped.
• Can it read a printed book or document? Yes. Take a photo of the page and Speak4Me reads the text out loud.
• Can it read web articles? Yes. Listen to articles, blog posts and newsletters instead of reading them on screen.
• Can it speak for me? Yes. Type any sentence and it is spoken out loud instantly. Save the phrases you use most for one-tap access.
• Can I use it as an AAC app? Yes. Speak4Me works as a simple type-to-speak communication tool for people who can't speak or find it hard to.
• Can I create AI voice-overs? Yes. Type a script, pick one of 120+ AI voices and export it as an MP3.
• Does it help with dyslexia? Yes. It offers a dyslexia-friendly font and highlights the text as it reads.
• Can I change the reading speed? Yes. Slow it down or speed it up to fit the way you listen.
• Which languages does it support? 20+ languages and accents, including American, British and Australian English, Spanish, French, German, Chinese and Japanese.
Questions or feature requests? Write to us at support@bakeryscent.com
SUBSCRIPTION
Monthly and yearly plans renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel anytime in Account Settings. Any unused free trial ends when you subscribe.
Privacy Policy: https://speak4me-3ac5f.web.app/policy/policy.html
Terms of Use: https://speak4me-3ac5f.web.app/policy/terms.html

It's easy to play, just "leave"!
Gather the heroes of the turbulent world and win with your strategy!

・ Those who want to become stronger every day
・ Those who want to play in a short time
・ Those who want to play easily with one-handed operation
