bluejetty:00090315:ios.description:
تطبيق توصيل ون يغطي مدينة صنعاء وعدن وإب وذمار والحديدة وتعز والمكلا في اليمن. 
بإمكانك الطلب من المطاعم والسوبرماركت و شي ان وجميع المحلات. وسنوصل طلبك في أسرع وقت، 
اطلب وجبات الإفطار والغداء والعشاء من مجموعة من المطاعم المتنوعة، وتمتع بخدمة عالية الجودة تتسم بالكرم والاحترافية. سيتم توصيل طلبك في الوقت المحدد وبأفضل صورة ممكنة.. كل ذلك يتم بكل يُسر و تساهيل.
يمكنك استعراض المطاعم والوجبات بكل يسر وسهولة، لأننا نؤمن أن الناس يستحقون خدمة راقية وسريعة. ومن ثم اختيار الوجبات والكميات.. وأخيراً تنفيذ الطلب وتتبعه.
 سيصل طلبك في أسرع وقت والدفع عند الإستلام, وصي على أكلك المفضل ودعنا نتولى الباقي!
 نحرص في شركة توصيل ون على التميز في تقديم خدمة أفضل: 
 توصيل سريع.
 مندوبي توصيل بمظهر راقي ولياقة عالية.
 توصيل الأكل ساخن ولذيذ، وكأنك في المطعم نفسه – جاك الأكل وأنت مرتاح في بيتك! 
نعمل على مدار الأسبوع لإضافة المزيد من المطاعم. ونعمل على مدار الساعة لتحسين التطبيق وتقديم تجربة استخدام سهلة. ونعمل على مدار الدقيقة لخدمتكم بأفضل مما تتصورون. 
سنحرص على تحسين الخدمة بإستمرار وتركيزنا الرئيسي في التالي: تحسين وتطوير البرنامج باستمرار. تقصير وقت التوصيل باستمرار. زيادة عدد المطاعم والمتاجر.
كل مندوب توصيل في توصيل ون هو سفير لخدمتنا، ننقل عبره السرعة والجودة والاحترام إلى باب بيتك.
تطبيق توصيل ون يمنحك تجربة فريدة في توصيل الطعام وكل شيء في اليمن. شركة توصيل ون هي إحدى خدمات التوصيل في اليمن حيث تقوم بتوصيل طلبات العملاء من المطاعم إلى المنازل والمكاتب.
التطبيق هو أول تطبيق ينتشر في عدة محافظات يمنية. حيث نقوم بتوصيل وجبات الطعام من مطاعم صنعاء وعدن وإب وذمار والحديدة وتعز والمكلا. 
يحتوى تطبيق توصيل ون على أفخم مطاعم اليمن لتوصيل الطعام منها إلى العملاء. خدمة توصيل ون في اليمن هي من الخدمات الأساسية التي يحتاج إليها الناس في الوقت الحالي. تطبيق توصيل ون عبارة عن برنامج دليفري حيث يعتبر ضمن أفضل شركات التوصيل في اليمن. نحرص على تقديم خدمة توصيل وجبات سريعة بحيث يصل الأكل في وقت قياسي، وبمستوى كرم يليق بعملائنا، لنمنحك تجربة توصيل تنقلك إلى أجواء من النعيم والراحة. 
ومن أشهر مطاعم صنعاء في التطبيق:
مؤسسة الشيباني للمطاعم 
مطاعم الأرض الخضراء
مطاعم الشيباني رويال
مطاعم البيك
المراسيم - عدن
مطاعم ومطابخ الطويل - عدن
مطعم الدار دارك (فرع الدائري) - إب
مطعم الدار دارك (فرع المعاين) - إب
مطعم بازوكا
مطعم الحمراء صنعاء
المطعم التركي 
الشيباني رويال 
مطعم الخطيب 
مطعم الحلواني 
مطعم الراسني 
المطعم الهندي صنعاء
رقم مطعم رويال بروستر
رويال بروستر منيو
رقم مطعم رويال بروستر يمن مول
رويال بروستر الأصبحي
رويال بروستد
مطعم الخطيب الستين
مطعم هرفي صنعاء
مطعم القوزي صنعاء
شاورما حواء
شوارما وكريب حازم صنعاء
مطعم بردايس – ذمار
مطعم وبروست ماكس (الصراري) - ذمار
مطعم مومباي داربار صنعاء‎
المطعم الهندي شارع بغداد
مطعم نيودلهي صنعاء
مطعم بومباي الهندي
مطعم رويال بروستر يمن مول
مطعم دريم سيتي – تعز الحوبان
مطعم الشميري – تعز المدينة
مطاعم الخطيب صنعاء
مطعم بروستايم – ذمار
مطعم أجواء طيبة (فوة المساكن) المكلا
مطعم ستار برجر شيراتون
وستجد في التطبيق افضل مطعم كباب في صنعاء، وافضل مطعم مندي في صنعاء، وافضل مطعم بروست في صنعاء وافضل مطعم في صنعاء اليمن وأفضل بيتزا في صنعاء وافضل مطعم في صنعاء وأفضل شاورما في صنعاء.
وتستطيع تحميل برنامج وجبات المطاعم والطلب عبر التطبيق ويوجد قسيمة خصم وجبات وتوصيل مجاني وستجد تطبيق وجباتي المفضلة.
تطبيق توصيل ون هو خدمة اطلب صنعاء ومحافظات اليمن ومتخصص كتطبيق وجبات من المطاعم ويحتوى على عروض وجبات من المطاعم وتوصيل طلبات مطاعم وبإمكانك الحصول على اقرب مطعم توصيل مجاني لتنفيذ طلبات توصيل ويحتوى التطبيق على رقم سفري (ارقام التواصل) للتوصيل إذا كان النت بطيء لديك.
ومن أهم المطاعم التي يحتويها لتطبيق وجبات رويال بروستر.
ويحتوي التطبيق اسماء مطاعم مشهورة في اليمن وأشهر كافيهات في صنعاء. 
توصيل ون في اليمن يعطيك ارقام توصيل طلبات لأشهر المطاعم مثل توصيل طلبات للمنازل وقد تحصل على توصيل طلبات مجانا في مسابقات الصفحة بالفيسبوك وحالات الواتساب.
ويمكنك التطبيق من إيجاد مطعم وجبات سريعة قريب بحيث تطلب طلب سفري. 
توصيل ون لتوصيل طلبات المطاعم هو خيارك الأفضل.

bluejetty:00070057:ios.description:
Battle your way through an Epic Open World RPG from the makers of Rodeo Stampede!
OPEN WORLD
Botworld is a huge, beautiful and diverse world which you can explore as you venture out to collect rare scrap and discover new bots. Enter new environments, meet a variety of characters, collect rare treasures and uncover the many secrets hidden in Botworld. You can freely explore the many lush forests and arid deserts but make sure you have a strong team of bots because you never know what's around the corner!
BATTLE
Outsmart your foes in a unique strategic battle system. Your bots will leap, charge, stun or blast around the arena using advanced AI while you pick the perfect abilities to stomp your foes. Each bot has unique abilities and a powerful ultimate, combine these with your favourite player abilities for maximum effect.
COLLECT & CUSTOMIZE
You will discover, build and collect rare and powerful bots to create the ultimate team. Search the world to discover new bot recipes and collect rare scrap to build and upgrade your favourites. Customise their powers and abilities as they level up and get stronger.
CHOOSE YOUR CHARACTER
Play as one of 4 species: cats, dogs, buffalo and lizards. Choose a unique look to add your own personality to the character.
CREATE OR JOIN A GUILD!
Now Botmasters can come together and collaborate in completing quests! Join an existing guild or create your own, with the ability to share strategies and discoveries through the guild text chat. When you have enough botmasters in your crew, venture forth and take on the guild exclusive events! Finish these so you can score some unique scrap and outfits!

bluejetty:00000594:ios.description:
ESS Mobile is a smart, adaptive app that, when used with your employer's Attendance on Demand system, provides employees with flexible time tracking options.
You have access to the information needed to track your hours worked and review schedules or benefit balances. Notifications can be sent when your time card needs action, such as the addition of a missing punch. Messages can be exchanged with your supervisor to record attendance-related activities like an absence or if you will be late for your shift.
Using ESS Mobile hourly employees may be able to punch in and out, request time off, or enter tips. For employees that simply report total hours worked multiple time sheet views are available. Additional operations such as entering mileage, expenses, or tips are also available.
Contact your payroll administrator or Attendance on Demand service provider for additional details.
Note: ESS Mobile uses location services to obtain your location during app usage. Continued use of the app or background GPS tracking can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00021062:ios.summary:
Stop begging your kids to do their chores. With Privilege Points, they'll beg YOU for the chance to earn rewards instead.
Set up a chore checklist for each child, assign points or cash to every task, and let them earn the privileges that a
bluejetty:00021062:ios.description:
Stop begging your kids to do their chores. With Privilege Points, they'll beg YOU for the chance to earn rewards instead.
Set up a chore checklist for each child, assign points or cash to every task, and let them earn the privileges that actually motivate them — screen time, allowance money, a sleepover. The chore tracker keeps everyone accountable without the nagging.
GREAT FOR ADHD & BEHAVIOR CHALLENGES
Chore charts and point systems are recommended by child psychologists for kids with ADHD, autism, and behavior challenges. Visual task lists, immediate rewards, and consistent routines help kids stay focused and build responsibility. The built-in behavior tracker and penalty system give parents a complete tool for encouraging good behavior — and parents of kids with ADHD consistently report fewer fights and more cooperation.
FLEXIBLE FOR EVERY FAMILY
Most chore apps force you into their system. Privilege Points adapts to yours. Mix points and cash. Reward good behaviors and penalize bad ones. Use it for chore tracking, behavior management, screen time limits, or allowance — or all of the above. You define the point values, the cost of each privilege, and the fine for every penalty.
POINTS FOR KIDS, CASH FOR TEENS
Younger kids love earning points and spending them on fun privileges. Older kids respond better to real money — Privilege Points grows with your family. Create cash chores and privileges to manage weekly allowance, or let older kids earn toward a savings goal. You decide when and how to introduce each child to money.
CHORE CHART & DAILY ROUTINE
Build a daily chore routine for each child with required tasks pinned to the top of their list. Add optional chores for extra earning opportunities. Set deadlines, frequency limits, and rotating assignments. Add good behaviors alongside chores to reinforce habits and responsibility.
POINT AND PRIVILEGE REQUESTS
Kids request points and privileges directly from their own phones. Parents review and approve — or deny — from theirs. No auto-crediting without your sign-off. Everyone stays in sync with instant notifications for every completed task and approved privilege.
TASK REMINDERS & BACKDATING
Set configurable reminders per child and per chore. Forgot to approve something yesterday? Backdating keeps your records accurate without the stress.
TIMED PRIVILEGES AND PENALTIES
A built-in timer tracks screen time limits and timed penalties across multiple kids simultaneously — no more manual timekeeping.
ALWAYS IN SYNC
All data lives securely in the cloud. Parents, grandparents, sitters, and caregivers can all participate. Install on as many devices as you'd like.
CHILD LOCK
Lock any device in read-only mode for a specific child or as a shared family device. Kids see their task list and point total — but can't change anything.
ACTIVITY HISTORY
A full record of every point earned and every privilege granted. Invaluable when there's any disagreement about what was completed.
Download Privilege Points today and stop negotiating with your kids about chores.

bluejetty:00089322:ios.description:
ByePhotos helps you easily organize your phone media files and free up valuable storage space.
• Worry-free Security – Completely local processing, no internet connection required, ensuring your privacy
• Smart Recognition – Automatically detects similar/duplicate photos and recommends the best options to keep
• Video Compression – Reduce file sizes while preserving visual clarity, helping you save space without noticeably compromising quality
• Efficient Organization – Quick classification with gestures, one-click deletion of unwanted photos
• Easy Continuity – Multiple organization modes (Random, By Month, Oldest First, Newest First), real-time progress display, supports pause and resume anytime
• Full Format Support – Compatible with photos, videos, Live Photos
Organize a little bit every day, say goodbye to cluttered albums.

WEALTH BUILDER (Beanstox Plus – $5/month): An expert-built, diversified ETF portfolio designed for people who want a personalized portfolio, diversified using a blend of ETFs to reduce risk. 
AI PORTFOLIO (available with Beanstox Premium): The easy & automated way to invest in the AI economy with four AI-focused ETFs. 
GOLD (available with Beanstox Premium): The easy & automated way to invest in Gold. No coins, no vaults, no hassle. Secure and Simple with ETFs.
BITCOIN (available with Beanstox Premium): The easy & automated way to invest in Bitcoin. Secure and Simple with ETFs.
STOCKS 500: Automated investing in an S&P 500 tracking ETF portfolio. Invest in 500 of the biggest U.S. companies.
POWER SAVINGS: Beanstox makes it easy to “skip the banks.” Get more on your invested cash compared to traditional savings accounts. 
WHY BEANSTOX
• Automated Investing: Recurring deposits and portfolio management handled for you.
• Start Small: Begin with as little as $10.
• Transparent Pricing*: One flat monthly fee. No trading commissions or hidden costs.

Kevin O’Leary (Mr. Wonderful from Shark Tank) and Connor O’Brien (CEO) co-founded Beanstox to make automated investing accessible for everyone, from first-time investors to busy professionals.

There's a couch, a table and a TV stand but not much els
bluejetty:00120815:ios.description:
You and your partner have just moved to a new home in the suburbs with your furry companion, an adorable cat named Snow. What to do first? Let's clean up so you can start decorating!
There's a couch, a table and a TV stand but not much else. What's missing here?! Oh... silly me, a TV of course. Let's buy that first!
But we can't just watch TV all day. Your partner needs to work and you have important chores around the house to do. Be sure to prepare meals for your partner and feed your kitty (or multiple, kitties as the case may be) to earn love. 
Use that love to buy more furniture, decorations, and yes... more CATS for your house to make it utterly adorable! The more cats you have, the more adorable moments you'll get. Capture them in snapshots with your retro camera and collect them all in your photo album.
Really enjoying the game?!? Gather enough love and unlock new areas like the Garden where you can gather love from woodland creatures that come to visit your adorable home.
Adorable Home is a passive and relaxing experience. Come back and check in on the game every couple hours to see something new, gather some love, and continue furnishing your home.
We hope you enjoy!
Adorable Home is LGBTQ+ friendly. It references mature themes and on occasion, depicts characters in revealing outfits; this is a game about partners inside their home (Bedroom, Bathroom, etc.) after all. It may be inappropriate for children.

bluejetty:00162148:ios.summary:
Deva & Miten's Gayatri Sangha - A gathering place for spiritual connection, meditation, mantra, songs, music and celebration.
Join Grammy-nominated Deva Premal & Miten's online Gayatri Sangha for live meditations and Q&As, and participate
bluejetty:00162148:ios.description:
Deva & Miten's Gayatri Sangha - A gathering place for spiritual connection, meditation, mantra, songs, music and celebration.
Join Grammy-nominated Deva Premal & Miten's online Gayatri Sangha for live meditations and Q&As, and participate in a community based on the values of compassion, forgiveness and gratitude.
Deva Premal and Miten have spent the past 28 years sharing their deeply meditative music and the healing power of Sanskrit mantras with the world. Their unique, 21st century vision of this ancient tradition has been employed as an aid to meditation, stress management, personal growth and conscious contemplation by countless devoted followers, worldwide.
In the Gayatri Sangha, you will find other like-minded kindred spirits from around the world. Share your prayers, meditation experiences, songs and stories – and recipes - with your spiritual community. And maybe even find a fellow traveller in your neighbourhood. Miracles await!
This is our Gayatri Sangha Online Community. A community based on the values of Compassion, Forgiveness and Gratitude.
Your subscription to the Gayatri Sangha gives you unlimited access to a host of features including:
- Regular app-only live music streams and regular live Q&A sessions with Deva & Miten
- App-only live meditations and tutorials with Deva & Miten including in-depth chats on music and life
- Exclusive content including visual meditation videos
- In-app events and programs
- Giving and receiving support through sharing our stories and spiritual experiences with like-minded souls.
- Possibility of establishing personal connection with other Gayatri Sangha beloveds in your neighbourhood
- Easy access to an ever-expanding library of mantras, songs and meditation practices all on your device
- Member-only offers including early access to events and discounts
PRICING INFORMATION:
This app requires a subscription to access the content: $11 a month or $108 a year. Prices are shown in your local currency before you subscribe.
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Your subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it.
- To cancel on iPhone, open Settings, tap your name, tap Subscriptions, tap Gayatri Sangha, then tap Cancel Subscription.
- You can cancel at any time.
Please find a link to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy below:
https://gayatrisangha.devapremalmiten.com/onboarding_documents

• Free content updates for the duration of your subscription
• Over 100 medications tables, searchable by generic or trade names
• Easy-to-use algorithms
• Assessment instruments that calculate responses 
• Fast, omnipresent search function
• Calculators for commonly used formulas and equations 
• A bookmark feature for frequently referenced content 
• Links to useful resources and websites
Purchase an annual subscription, so you always have the latest information. 
• For only $19.99, a subscription gives you access to the latest GAYF® content for 1 full year.
• Your subscription automatically renews every year, so you always have the latest content.

bluejetty:00145187:ios.description:

Com atendimento de segunda à segunda, de 7h às 22h, Bluma é o autocuidado que se encaixa na sua rotina. É a melhor opção para ter mais comodidade, segurança e conforto.
Na Bluma, você faz: 
Unhas: manicure e pedicure. 
Massagem: relaxante, drenagem linfática, modeladora drenomodeladora, reflexologia, desportiva e shiatsu. 
Depilação: feminina e masculina. 
Serviços de estética: limpeza de pele tradicional ou com hidratação. 
Cabelos: escova e escova modeladora. 
Maquiagem: básica, glam ou by Natura UNA. 
Seu momento de autocuidado com especialistas de verdade: todas as nossas especialistas passam por um rigoroso processo de seleção, treinamento e atendem nossos rígidos critérios de biossegurança. Tudo para garantir o melhor atendimento e resultado ideal no seu serviço.
E tem mais:
> Pagamento seguro, feito direto no app, via cartão de crédito ou PIX.
> Clube para você que quer mais praticidade e controle da sua rotina.
> Especialistas que levam todos os materiais necessários para o serviço.
> Agendamentos em menos de 1 minuto.
> Suporte 100% humanizado.
Chega de procurar “manicure perto de mim”, “manicure em casa”, “cabeleireiro a domicilio”, “massagem perto de mim”, “maquiadora para eventos”, “depilação em casa” e outros serviços do tipo no Google.
Com a Bluma, os serviços de beleza e bem-estar vão até você, no seu tempo. 
Até o momento, Bluma atende as cidades de São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Belo Horizonte e o Distrito Federal, mas logo estaremos também na sua região!
Singu agora é Bluma. Uma marca com a confiança Natura.
Agende agora seu atendimento!

Snoodoku combines classic Sudoku gameplay with the colorful charm of Snood, giving players a fun and relaxing way to challenge their minds every day. Solve familiar grid-based puzzles, choose from five difficulty levels, and discover new ways to play every day.

Features
• Classic Sudoku gameplay with a unique Snood twist
• Five difficulty levels: Child, Easy, Medium, Hard, and Evil 
• Daily Challenges with streak tracking 
• Weekly Tournaments with fun in-game prizes
• Collectible Postcard Events
• Helpful hints and easy-to-use gameplay tools

• Colorful Snood characters and personality 
Play at your own pace, improve your skills, or compete for a top tournament ranking. Snoodoku brings the timeless strategy of Sudoku into the playful world of Snood. 
From the creators of Snood, entertaining puzzle fans for over 30 years, Snoodoku brings the personality and charm of the Snood universe to classic Sudoku.

Here’s what else you can do with cbozark app:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back

View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you

To use the cbozark app, you must be enrolled as a Commercial Bank of Ozark digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00117065:ios.description:
Brant Taxi is the leading provider of Taxi services in Brantford and surrounding areas.
We are pleased to offer our valued clients the very latest in smartphone booking technology with our free Brant Taxi application.
Key Features of the Brant Taxi app include:
• Book a trip in as few as 2 clicks
• Monitor the progress of your vehicle on a map
• Create a list of favourite addresses and assign a custom name for each
• Review all reservations you have made over the past 30 days
• Provide feedback related to the application and/or service you received
• Call Brant Taxi with the push of a button
To begin using the Brant Taxi app today:
• Download the free app
• Enter your phone number
• Validate your account (via the notification code you receive)
• Login to the app (Set your name and Email for receipts)
• Enter your pickup address
• Enter your destination address (this allows us to provide an estimated fare amount)

bluejetty:00156738:ios.description:

The digital museum of the seven-time Formula 1 World Champion is an intense and rich experience for every motorsport enthusiast.
The app enables a virtual visit to the Michael Schumacher Private Collection at MOTORWORLD Cologne-Rhineland and a virtual tour of the historic Kerpen-Manheim kart track, where Michael Schumacher as a child laid the foundation for his driving skills - in both cases, VR glasses, which can be ordered directly from the app, offer an even more detailed insight.

For each car, further information such as the exact history or the engine sound is offered. A detailed statistics section with the most important records explains the career of the most successful driver in Formula 1. In a video interview from 2013, Michael Schumacher gives his answers to questions that define a champion.

bluejetty:00159794:ios.summary: With the Thrive Connect app, you can easily share your way to success with tools that create word-of-mouth buzz and complement belly-to-belly efforts! Connect with new contacts and interact with your team by sharing exclusive, corporate-app
bluejetty:00159794:ios.description:
With the Thrive Connect app, you can easily share your way to success with tools that create word-of-mouth buzz and complement belly-to-belly efforts! Connect with new contacts and interact with your team by sharing exclusive, corporate-approved tools. You’ll have a vast array of marketing materials like videos, images, and more—all right at your fingertips! The powerful, yet beautifully simple design, along with compelling tools, makes growing your business simpler than ever.
Contacts: Choose how to sync and manage your contacts. Swipe to sort them by interest level. You can make connections, add notes, or check out the Contact Feed to see the tools you’ve shared and contact actions.
Tools: It has never been easier to share information about your products and opportunity via SMS text, email, or social media. Simply choose tools specifically designed to promote your business and share them with a contact. You’ll receive a notification when contacts view a tool so you know exactly when to follow up! You can even add your own tools. Record or upload short videos to share with prospects. You can even add actions to your videos so prospects can interact directly in the video. These smarter interactive tools are called a Brightool and they provide more data for follow up with ActionAlert notifications in the Feed. No data connection? No problem! Simply download tools such as videos in the app beforehand for offline playback.
Business: Access helpful links to build your business.
Settings: Our simple Share Setup will help you upload a profile picture, define your ‘why’ in your bio, and add other info that will help contacts connect with you and learn more about your business and products. You can also configure notification preferences, watch QuickTips to learn about the app, and more.
Learn: Empowering users by providing simple
 and effective training courses, lessons, quizzes, awards, and more.
With videos, images, PDFs, quotes and more built into the lessons, you can learn more than ever and have fun while doing it.

Download today and unlock a powerful tool for mastering Cantonese and English with confidence.

bluejetty:00160586:ios.description:
Learn the Bible With Friends
Ascend turns Bible study into something you can do together.
Learn through short interactive lessons, share what you’re discovering, join Bible studies with friends, pray for each other, and grow your faith alongside people you actually know. Along the way, raise your own phoenix companion, earn rewards, build streaks, and make Scripture part of your everyday life.
Whether you're opening the Bible for the first time or trying to build a stronger daily habit, Ascend makes learning Scripture feel social, interactive, and worth coming back to.
Why Choose Ascend?
• Learn the Bible with friends through shared Bible studies, reflections, challenges, and conversations
• Complete interactive lessons, quizzes, streaks, and XP progression together
• Join Crusades, small-group Bible studies built around the idea that “iron sharpens iron”
• Share what you're learning and encourage friends in their faith
• Pray for friends and loved ones through Ascend’s prayer hub
• Raise your own phoenix companion and help it evolve as you grow
• Visit friends’ dens, leave gifts, and see how their journey is progressing
• Earn relics, cosmetics, gems, and other rewards as you study
Bible Study That Feels Social
Bible study doesn’t have to be something you do alone.
Ascend gives you a place to learn Scripture alongside friends, talk about what you're reading, answer questions together, and keep each other consistent.
You can:
• Join Bible studies with friends
• Share reflections from your lessons
• Discuss Scripture and faith together
• Pray for one another
• Build streaks and grow alongside your friends
• Visit each other’s dens and leave gifts
What You'll Experience
• Interactive Bible lessons that usually take less than ten minutes
• Personalized study plans covering Scripture, theology, church history, and Christian living
• Bible quizzes, verse challenges, and reflection questions that help lessons stick
• Daily streaks, XP milestones, badges, and leaderboards
• A phoenix companion that grows alongside your journey
• A customizable den filled with relics you earn through studying and challenges
• Multiple Bible translations, including KJV, ESV, and NIV
Free Features
• Full access to Bible lessons and courses
• Fifteen energy bars each day, with ways to earn more
• Crusades and social Bible-study features
• Your own phoenix companion and full evolution path
• Daily challenges and streak tracking
• Battle Pass rewards, gems, cosmetics, and collectibles
• Prayer and community features
Upgrade to Ascend Premium
• Unlimited energy so you can study whenever you want
• An ad-free experience
• Premium Battle Pass rewards and exclusive cosmetics
• A daily Relic Chest for your den
• Streak Shields, XP multipliers, Heart Refills, and other boosts
• Support Ascend’s mission to help more people learn the Bible
Perfect For
• Friends who want to learn the Bible together
• Christians looking for people to grow in faith with
• Small groups looking for a more interactive Bible-study experience
• People trying to build a consistent daily Scripture habit
• Anyone who wants Bible study to feel more social and engaging
Grow in Faith Together
Ascend is more than a Bible study app. It’s a place to learn Scripture with friends, encourage each other, pray together, and make growing in faith part of everyday life.
Your phoenix, streaks, rewards, and den make the journey fun. But the heart of Ascend is simple:
Learn the Bible. Grow your faith. Do it together.
Download Ascend and start learning the Bible with friends today.

bluejetty:00087747:ios.description:
Your gut has a story to tell — Happy Poop helps you listen.
Whether you deal with constipation, diarrhea, or just want to understand your body better, Happy Poop is the friendly, private, and fun way to track your bowel health.
TRACK YOUR POOP
Use the Bristol scale to classify your poop and record traits like duration, quantity, color, and mood. Add personal notes or photos. Create an account to keep your data safely backed up online — or keep everything on-device if you prefer. Either way, your privacy is always respected.
TRACK PEE & MENSTRUATION
Log your pee and menstrual cycle alongside your bowel data, for a more complete picture of your body.
BUILD BETTER HABITS
Track habits like hydration, sleep, exercise, diet — or anything else you care about. Just tap the pencil icon to fully customize the habit list. Happy Poop helps you see how your daily routine affects your gut, helping you break cycles of constipation or discomfort.
UNDERSTAND YOUR PATTERNS

It’s Mother’s Day 2026. It's almost always that mom has the strongest and the quietest influence on us. She balances so many roles and she does it all with a smile. And though we feel it in our hearts, but sometimes leave our appreciation unsaid. Mother's Day is the perfect time to show her your love and make her feel special with our warm Mother's Day ecards.
A whole lot of Mother’s Day cards in various categories are there on a platter for you.  
1. Happy Mother’s Day Wishes
2. Family Ecards
3. Love You Mom Cards
4. First Mother’s Day Wishes
5. Mother’s Day Fun 
6. Hugs 
7. Special Mom Cards
8. Flower Wishes for Mom’s
9. Make Her Smile Cards
10. Between Women
11. Dia De Las Madres
12. Friends 
  Key Highlights of the App –
  • Enjoy the flavor of each new event with this app. This time it is Mother’s Day 2026. No need to look any further for wishing your loved ones.
 • Get access to over 100’s of Mother’s Day 2026 FREE E-Cards from your mobile. 
• This app will cover all the major holidays being celebrated around the Year and will keep you updated automatically with the latest events and holidays Cards and help you select the best Cards for your loved ones at the right time. 
Upcoming holidays/events to be added – Memorial Day, Father's Day, 4th of July, Friendship Day, Rosh Hashanah, Boss's Day, Halloween, Diwali, Christmas, New Year , Valentine’s Day , Women’s Day , St. Patrick’s Day , Easter and more.

• Create deeper bonds with friends & family using inspiring e-Greetings that do more than convey your heart felt wishes for them. 
• Schedule delivery of ecards up to 60 days in advance for pleasant surprises.  
• Video, Animated, Postcard and Gif type ecards to be shared with the world for FREE!!  
• Send cards to multiple contacts.
The App is supported by contextual advertisements, and is absolutely free for the users.  The user data being used in the mobile application is only visible and accessible by the user.
Terms of use: https://www.123greetings.com/terms_of_use.html  
Policy: https://www.123greetings.com/privacy_policy.html

bluejetty:00183321:ios.name: J.O.E.®
bluejetty:00183321:ios.summary:
JURA Operating Experience (J.O.E.®)
J.O.E.® - digital operation
"With J.O.E.®, you can conveniently operate your JURA automatic speciality coffee machine via your iPhone, iPad or Apple Watch. You can make settings for your automatic special
bluejetty:00183321:ios.description:
JURA Operating Experience (J.O.E.®)
J.O.E.® - digital operation
"With J.O.E.®, you can conveniently operate your JURA automatic speciality coffee machine via your iPhone, iPad or Apple Watch. You can make settings for your automatic specialty coffee machine with ease via the app. Operating instructions, explanatory videos and tips are at your fingertips wherever you are, and you can get answers to almost any question. For unanswered ones, customer service is at your side in just a few clicks. You can also order products easily and securely from the JURA e-store.
J.O.E.® is compatible with all JURA automatic coffee machines equipped with Smart Connect or Wi-Fi Connect. Simply operate your automatic machine with the app and enjoy perfect coffee specialties en vogue and according to your personal taste."
Coffee enjoyment
Coffee strength, water quantity, temperature and milk foam: you can easily adjust the basic settings of your automatic speciality coffee machine to your personal taste via the app. You can also easily expand the existing variety of coffee specialties with your own creations. You can even personalize them with an individual image.
Support
Need help or have questions? In the app you will find the operating instructions, tips and explanatory videos. If a question should ever remain unanswered, connect to our customer service shortly.
JURA Cockpit
"Do you need to change the filter cartridge or clean the coffee machine? You'll receive notifications about upcoming care and cleaning tasks directly on your iPhone or iPad. You can also view statistics quickly and easily in the app. Would you like to know the number of coffees prepared or the number of cleanings performed? No problem, your data is available to you at any time.
JURA E-Store
Easy and secure shopping: Care products, accessories and spare parts. In the JURA E-Store you will find all our products for our automatic speciality coffee machines. If required, order them directly via J.O.E.® and have your purchase conveniently delivered to your home. 
Operation
With Siri and the Apple Watch, you can operate JURA fully automatic coffee machines even smarter. You can prepare your coffee simply by voice command or with a tap of your finger on the Apple Watch.
Extra
If you are hosting a large group of people or holding a business meeting, you can conveniently enter the desired coffee specialties of your guests or customers in the app. Guaranteed, no order will ever be forgotten again.
Award
J.O.E.® 4.0 has been awarded the Red Dot Design Award in the Design Concept category.
Innovations
We are constantly developing the J.O.E.® app. Some of the advantages you currently benefit from:
- Direct ordering of products in the integrated JURA e-store.
- New design for easier operation
- Extended functions in the JURA Cockpit, thanks to the new J.O.E.® account.
Do you like the app? Rate us. By doing so, you will help us to make J.O.E.® even better.

bluejetty:00022607:ios.name: CycleComputer
bluejetty:00022607:ios.summary:
CycleComputer is an iPhone app designed to track speed, distance and route in real time when cycling. It has three unique ride information displays and can manage rides history. 
Main features 
- Three different displays to choose from : d
bluejetty:00022607:ios.description:
CycleComputer is an iPhone app designed to track speed, distance and route in real time when cycling. It has three unique ride information displays and can manage rides history. 
Main features 
- Three different displays to choose from : digital, analog and map, each with large readings that let you capture all the information with just a glance
- Easy to use, number of screens kept to a minimum
- "Automode" that automatically stops the timer when you stop moving
- Swipe horizontally to switch between digital, analog and map screens
- Support for both metric(km) and imperial(mi) readings
- Save, browse and review rides
- Calculate total ascent and calories for each ride
- Background operation
- Sharing ride details by email, on Facebook/Twitter
- Share ride data(distance/calories) with Apple Health
DISPLAYS 
-Digital 
Looks like an actual cyclocomputer. Uses very large fonts to let you capture all the information with just a glance. Uses very little power, good for cyclists who go for long rides.
- Analog 
Looks like a car speedometer. 
- Map 
Displays the speed, time and distance, tracks your ride on a map(Apple/Google) with optional distance markers. 
NOTE 
- The background operation option must be enabled for the app to keep running in the background
Warning : Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00152691:ios.description:
Welcome to Peak Climbing, a gripping survival adventure where every decision could mean life or death. Endure harsh environments, manage scarce resources, and climb your way to the summit… if you can survive the journey.
Peak Climbing: Survive. Scale. Conquer.
 Survival Climbing Adventure
Scale dangerous cliffs, spiky edges, and steep peaks. Every climb uses stamina. Injuries and hunger make each step harder. The higher you go, the tougher it gets.
- Scavenge for Supplies
Open scattered suitcases and wreckage to find items. Some food is fresh. Some… isn’t. Use what you find to push forward — or risk falling behind.
- Watch Your Health
Injuries reduce your stamina. Use bandages and medicine to stay in shape. The cold drains your energy faster. Shelter and warm gear help you survive longer.
- Explore & Discover
Find clues, notes, and lost gear from others who tried to climb. Learn what happened — and what lies at the top.
- Features:
• Survival-focused climbing gameplay.
• Limited inventory and smart resource choices.
• Stamina, hunger, and injury systems.
• Immersive sound and atmosphere.
• Simple controls, deep challenge.
Will you reach the PEAK, or become part of the mountain?
Player Peak Climbing and find it yourself!

Trained on insights from top dating coaches and built by AI experts from Stanford and Google, Smoothspeak does not just hand you clever lines. It helps you actually get better.
Inside Smoothspeak, you’ll meet Cue, your personal AI dating coach. Cue reads your situation, gives tailored guidance, and explains the moves behind it.
HOW IT WORKS:
DROP IN A SCREENSHOT:
Profiles, dating apps, DMs, and group chats. Cue understands the context, even mixed sets like a profile plus a chat.
GET COACHED, NOT SCRIPTED:
Receive tailored replies that match the vibe and the person, with the reasoning behind them. Want it warmer or more playful? Just chat with Cue like a friend who is really good at this.
TYPE WITH THE SMOOTHSPEAK KEYBOARD:
Bring Cue into any app: Tinder, Bumble, Hinge, iMessage, Instagram DMs, WhatsApp, Snap, and more.
GLOW UP YOUR PROFILE AND PHOTOS:
Upload your photos or full dating profile and get AI-powered feedback, including personalized ratings, style tips, and exactly what to change to stand out.
PERSONAS: SHIFT THE VIBE WITH ONE TAP:
Switch styles to fit the moment: Friendly, Romantic, Playful, Confident, and more. Each persona changes word choice, pacing, and energy.
WHY SMOOTHSPEAK?
A real coach’s perspective, not just clever one-liners. Cue tells you why something works so you actually improve.
It remembers your past conversations with each person, like a coach who knows your history.
Profile, photo, and conversation help in one place, so your whole dating life gets leveled up.
Coach-informed AI trained on techniques from top dating coaches.
Trusted by 200,000+ people transforming their dating lives every day.
WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH SMOOTHSPEAK:
• Standout openers that get replies

• A clear read on every match: interest level, signals, and what to do next
• Smooth, low-pressure ways to move from texting to a real plan
• Tone shifts: warmer, funnier, more confident, more direct
• A full glow-up of your dating profile and photos
• Daily check-ins with Cue to track progress and stay on plan
• Rewrites of your own drafts in Rizzify mode

SMOOTHSPEAK TRANSFORMS YOUR DATING LIFE, END TO END.

Smoothspeak is the AI dating coach app that helps you become a better, more confident version of yourself across every part of your dating life: your conversations, your profile, and your dates. Trained on insights from top dating coaches and built by AI experts from Stanford and Google, Smoothspeak does not just hand you clever lines. It helps you actually get better.

Inside Smoothspeak, you’ll meet Cue, your personal AI dating coach. Cue reads your situation, gives tailored guidance, and explains the moves behind it.

HOW IT WORKS:

DROP IN A SCREENSHOT:
Profiles, dating apps, DMs, and group chats. Cue understands the context, even mixed sets like a profile plus a chat.

GET COACHED, NOT SCRIPTED:
Receive tailored replies that match the vibe and the person, with the reasoning behind them. Want it warmer or more playful? Just chat with Cue like a friend who is really good at this.

TYPE WITH THE SMOOTHSPEAK KEYBOARD:
Bring Cue into any app: Tinder, Bumble, Hinge, iMessage, Instagram DMs, WhatsApp, Snap, and more.

GLOW UP YOUR PROFILE AND PHOTOS:
Upload your photos or full dating profile and get AI-powered feedback, including personalized ratings, style tips, and exactly what to change to stand out.

PERSONAS: SHIFT THE VIBE WITH ONE TAP:
Switch styles to fit the moment: Friendly, Romantic, Playful, Confident, and more. Each persona changes word choice, pacing, and energy.

WHY SMOOTHSPEAK?

A real coach’s perspective, not just clever one-liners. Cue tells you why something works so you actually improve.
It remembers your past conversations with each person, like a coach who knows your history.
Profile, photo, and conversation help in one place, so your whole dating life gets leveled up.
Coach-informed AI trained on techniques from top dating coaches.
Trusted by 200,000+ people transforming their dating lives every day.

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH SMOOTHSPEAK:

• Standout openers that get replies
• Replies that keep good conversations alive
• A clear read on every match: interest level, signals, and what to do next
• Smooth, low-pressure ways to move from texting to a real plan
• Tone shifts: warmer, funnier, more confident, more direct
• A full glow-up of your dating profile and photos
• Daily check-ins with Cue to track progress and stay on plan
• Rewrites of your own drafts in Rizzify mode

JOIN THE SMOOTHSPEAK COMMUNITY.

Free to download. Some features require a subscription or in-app purchase.
Upgrade to unlock unlimited suggestions with our best models or dating profile reviews.

Support: support@smoothspeak.ai

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00184780:ios.summary: Play 28 Solitaire game variants in 10 exciting game types all in one free Collection (Previously known as Solitaire Bliss Collection): Solitaire (Klondike), Spider Solitaire, Freecell, Pyramid, Tripeaks, Yukon, Golf, Scorpion, 8 Off and For
bluejetty:00184780:ios.description:
Play 28 Solitaire game variants in 10 exciting game types all in one free Collection (Previously known as Solitaire Bliss Collection): Solitaire (Klondike), Spider Solitaire, Freecell, Pyramid, Tripeaks, Yukon, Golf, Scorpion, 8 Off and Forty Thieves.
SOLITAIRE
Take a break and enjoy the classic game of Solitaire! Play random or solvable deals, and choose between Classic or Vegas scoring.
SPIDER SOLITAIRE
Our personal favorite! Play an easy 1 suit game, a normal 2 suit game, or challenge yourself to a 4 suit game.
FREECELL
The card game that makes you think!
Beginners can start with the Easy mode, where some cards are already in order, while advanced players will enjoy the Classic game with known numbered deals and detailed personal statistics.
TRIPEAKS
Fun and fast, Tripeaks and Hidden Tripeaks are always a pleasure to play.
YUKON
Difficult yet challenging! Choose between Yukon, Russian and Alaska Solitaire.
FORTY THIEVES
In this game type, only one pass through the stock is allowed, plan wisely!
PYRAMID
Considered one of the hardest Solitaire games, only 0.5% of Classic Pyramid games are won, but don’t worry, you can always play a solvable deal!
GOLF
Enjoy classic Golf, or give yourself a break and try out the easy variant!
SCORPION SOLITAIRE
A hybrid between Spider Solitaire and Yukon Solitaire, the cards can be moved like in Yukon, but are moved to the foundations like in Spider.
EIGHT OFF
Try the original Freecell game with a twist - Eight cells instead of Four, we also offer the easy difficulty level where any card can be moved to an empty pile.
Features:
- Random and Solvable deals
- Unlimited undos and hints
- Daily challenges with leaderboards
- Game statistics tracker 
- Personal records
- Built-in achievements
- Left-handed mode
- Various card designs
- Beautiful backgrounds
- Autocomplete
- Play on tablets and phones
- Portrait and landscape modes available
- No network required!
- Multiple languages
- How to play, rules and tips sections
- Drag and drop a card or just tap to move it
- Your game is saved automatically upon exit, continue your last game anytime!
And even more unique features:
- For Klondike - Vegas rules with or without cumulative score
- For Spider Solitaire - an option to control whether tap will consider different suits 
- For Spider Solitaire - an option to allow card dealing to empty piles
- For Freecell - try out the 32000 known numbered deals
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00040834:ios.description:
Have you ever misplaced your headphones and spent hours searching for them? Worry no more! With Find Air, you can quickly and easily locate your lost gadgets.
Key Features:
- Find a Wide Range of Bluetooth Devices 
Find Air helps you locate a wide range of Bluetooth devices, compatible with AirPods,AirTag, wireless headphones, Tiles and laptops, fitness trackers like Fitbit, and other Bluetooth-enabled devices.
- Locate Devices on Map
Track the approximate location of your lost device on a map, making it easier than ever to pinpoint its whereabouts.
- Signal Strength Radar
Use the intuitive signal strength radar to determine how close you are to your lost device. The stronger the signal, the closer you are!
- Fast and Easy to Use
Simply open the app, select your missing device from the list of detected devices, and start tracking it immediately.
How It Works:
• Open the app and select the device you want to find from the list.
• Move around and follow the signal strength or check the map to find your device.
• Yay, you've found your device nearby!
Whether you've misplaced your headphones, left your smartwatch in another room, or dropped your Bluetooth speaker somewhere, Find Air is here to help you retrieve your valuable gadgets.
Subscribe to Find Air Pro for full access to all features!
- The subscription will be automatically renewed unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the expiration of the current subscription period. 
- You will be charged a renewal fee within 24 hours before the expiration of the current subscription period according to the rates of the selected subscription. 
- You can disable automatic subscription renewal in App Store at any moment after making a purchase. 
Terms of Service: https://sites.google.com/view/findair-tems
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/findair-privacy

bluejetty:00126876:ios.description:
Selfie-A-Day is a history of you. Take a selfie every day and play them back in fun, life capturing movies.
Instantly play your selfie movies inside the app and save them directly to your Camera Roll or share to Instagram, Facebook, Twitter and Tik Tok.
Already have a bunch of selfies? Easily import them into the app from your Camera Roll. 
The Backup feature saves all of your photos to your Camera Roll for safe keeping. 
Use our built-in camera grid or ghost image view to line up your face day after day. The longer you Selfie-A-Day the better your results will be! 
Set reminders in the app to make sure that you never miss a selfie. Search through dates to easily remember how you looked on that special occasion.
NEW: Easily sync all of your selfies to your Dropbox account as you take them!
NEW: Password protect your Selfie Albums and unlock them with a scan of your fingerprint with Touch ID or using your face with Face ID!
NEW: Access your Selfie Albums quickly using 3D Touch and Siri Shortcuts!
Along with selfies, Selfie-A-Day is perfect for tracking:
- Weight loss transformation
- Your kids growing up 
- Daily makeup
- Growing baby bump
- Fun facial hair
- Your pets
- Flipbook and stop motion
- All of life's moments
Privacy policy: https://selfieaday.ca/privacy-policy.pdf
Terms and conditions: https://selfieaday.ca/terms-and-conditions.pdf
A Selfie-A-Day keeps the doctor away. We're here to support the Selfie-A-Dayers. Please reach out to us with feedback at contact@freezegun.com.

SOUND Q
bluejetty:00022625:ios.description:
Your music, your sound. A complete music player for the files you own, with the equalizer most players leave out.
Shape every song with a 5-band EQ that is always free. Go further with MPX Pro: ten bands, and a full parametric EQ.
SOUND QUEST — TEACH YOUR EARS
Five short lessons that show what each band actually does. The music is built in, so there is nothing to import before you start. Hear bass, mids and treble one at a time, then all three at once, and finish with the sliders in your hands.
PARAMETRIC CONTROL
Frequency, gain and Q on every band, set independently. Bypass a single filter to hear what it was doing. Tune around your headphones, your speakers and your own ears.
YOUR LIBRARY, WHEREVER IT LIVES
• Import from Files, iCloud Drive, Google Drive, Dropbox, and other file providers
• Connect to Jellyfin, Navidrome, and compatible music servers
• Play FLAC, WAV, MP3, M4A, and more without an internet connection
• Create playlists, save favorites, and organize your own library
• Fix song, album, artist, and artwork information without modifying the original files
MORE THAN AN EQUALIZER
• Smart Transitions: Crossfade, Echo Out, Tape Stop, and Pitch Drop
• Loudness Leveling for consistent volume across a mixed library
• Smart Start for skipping low-energy song intros
• Song Timer for timed track changes that keep a workout moving
• Visualizers drawn from your own album art
• Pitch and playback-speed controls
• CarPlay support
• No ads
FREE TO START. POWERFUL WHEN YOU’RE READY.
The player, the 5-band EQ, and Sound Quest are free. MPX Pro adds the 10-band and Parametric EQs, saved presets, and the advanced playback tools — monthly, yearly, or once for good.
Your library. Your sound. Full control.
Terms of Use & Privacy Policy:
https://www.mpxeq.com/policy

apple-macos:1232603544.name: HTTPBot: API & HTTP Client
apple-macos:1232603544.description:
HTTPBot is a powerful API client and debugger that lets you send HTTP/HTTPs requests, connect to WebSockets, browse and invoke remote MCP servers, inspect JSON & HTML responses, and debug APIs on the go.
With HTTPBot, you can
 - Make requests and view responses from anywhere.
 - Debug API issues even while away from your terminal. 
 - Work with JSON, HTML, XML, and raw text responses effortlessly.
 - Collaborate with your team by importing & exporting Postman collections, and by syncing with the Postman API.
FEATURES
 - Powerful request editor provides a GUI for easily editing HTTP, HTTPS & WebSockets requests.
 - Connect to remote MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to browse and invoke their tools, prompts, and resources.
 - Supports all major HTTP methods, including GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, HEAD, and OPTIONS.
 - Automatically highlights JSON, HTML, and XML content for better readability. 
 - View detailed metrics for requests and responses, including size, duration, SSL and more. 
 - Support for OpenAPI/Swagger specs as well as Postman collections & environments, including sync with Postman accounts on the cloud 
 - View request documentation for APIs
 - Native support for GraphQL requests - edit queries and variables directly, and view schema.
 - Import & export collections from/to any document storage provider, like iCloud Drive, Dropbox and more.
 - Supports authentication using Basic, Digest, OAuth 1.0a, OAuth 2.0, JWT and much more. Securely store auth credentials for frequent use.
 - Save frequently-used variables in environments
 - Filter & query responses using XPath & JSONPath
 - Automate your workflows with Shortcuts integration.
PRICING
HTTPBot is available to download for free, with a risk-free 7-day trial to unlock access to its features. Enjoy full access beyond the trial with a yearly subscription, or a one-time purchase for a lifetime upgrade. All plans unlock the app on all platforms where it is supported.

CREATE FLOWS, NOT JUST MIND MAPS
Creating flows is just like creating mind maps. But without the restrictions. Let flows converge or loop back around. All while retaining the same intuitive workflow.

Define your flow and the relationships between different elements. The layout happens automatically while you are working. To adjust the layout, you can reorganize elements using drag-and-drop.
MAKE CHANGES WITHOUT WORRYING ABOUT THE DETAILS
No matter what you change, the layout will automatically adapt. Paste a whole subflow into the middle of the flow. Delete any part of the flow, no matter how intertwined. You won’t have to spend most of your time fixing the layout.

FIND YOUR STYLE
Style each node and connector. Quickly reuse styles across your graph using the automatically generated library. Find the right look for new files using our premade templates or your own custom templates.
SHARE AND EXPORT WITHOUT SURPRISES
Easily share your creations in popular file formats (PDF and PNG). In high quality and without fuss. It is that simple.
INPUT BEYOND THE TOUCH
We think we built the qui(c)kest way to create a flow using touch. But QuikFlow started on desktop. And we brought all the mouse and keyboard support over to iPad.
